items.original: 【翼·年代记 记录贴】这种掌握人情感的多样化的漫画太神奇了 明明没有体会过这种事情但是看完了之后总是像感同身受一样 我太爱这部漫了  可谓虐心才会让人印象深刻  c妈带来的世界真是超级棒  这种超前的世界观真的让人惊叹「关键那个年代创造出的漫」 每个人物我都爱 都给我带来不同的感受 没有谁好谁坏 谁对谁错之分 哪怕是飞王 在我看来他只是想复活侑子这个愿望去努力实现罢了  从每个人不同的角度出发 每个人都没错 但是相融在一起 又会产生矛盾 这就产生了每个人都没错 但每个人又有错的感觉啊 总之 真的是被c妈们天马行空的想象 催人泪下的情节  不求回报的真挚友情 还有穿越时空的恋情所折服！
items.translation: [Tsubasa Chronicle Record Post] This kind of manga that masters diverse human emotions is so amazing. Even though I've never experienced such things, after reading it, I always feel as if I can empathize. I love this manga so much. It can be said that heart-wrenching stories leave a deep impression. The world brought by CLAMP is truly superb. This kind of advanced worldview is really astonishing. [The key is that it was created in that era.] I love every character; each brings me different feelings. There's no distinction of who is good or bad, right or wrong. Even Fei Wang, in my view, is just trying hard to fulfill his wish of revelling Yuko. From each person's different perspective, no one is wrong, but when they come together, conflicts arise. This creates the feeling that no one is wrong, yet everyone is at fault. In short, I am truly captivated by CLAMP's boundless imagination, tear-jerking plots, sincere and selfless friendships, and love that transcends time and space!

items.original: #小作文# 「回忆＋小说篇」◾以前在崇文上初中最快乐的时候莫过于周五了，熬过上午的四堂课，中午随便吃点饭，然后拿着零花钱去小卖部采购，那种1元一包的小零食，还有每次必买的2.5一袋的三根卤豆干，我那时候还可爱吃怡口莲～满载而归回到教室，下午就可以坐校车回家啦。校车分两个批次，我是第二批，还能在学校里写写作业，半个小时的路程就能到家啦，校车上的车载电视会放电影、MV还有《屌丝男士》，不过由于晕车的缘故我一般都只是望向窗外纯听声音。到家的那一刻是久违的家的感觉，那个小客厅有着和教室里不一样的空气，开电视，拉开抽屉把手机开机，时隔一周回家的喜悦惬意真的太难忘，晚上等妈妈回来一起去另一个屋里看电视聊天吃零食。周一起床实在太痛苦，夜里每醒一次都要看看手机几点了，算一下距离起床还能睡几个小时。冬天上学真的要起好早，四点半起天都是黑乎乎的，回家做最晚的一批车走，上学坐最早的一批车来，我有时候望着漆黑的车窗外还在脑补路边会不会突然冲出来一个白衣女鬼。教室里也是黑乎乎的，人性化的校长允许我们早班车来的可以在教室睡觉，然鹅，大多数的同学们都会利用这宝贵的时间来补作业。◾初中的时候开始看起了小说，当时学校小卖部里有卖一本叫《花火》的小说杂志，里面有很多短篇青春校园小说，在学校里看小说杂志，回到家就在手机上看电子书。那时候可流行霸道总裁、黑道男友、校草文了，但我只喜欢看纯纯的校园爱情，当然还有恐怖小说（哈！我真是与众不同）◾我的第一部手机上自带了掌阅书城APP，一次偶然的机会在上面花了4块钱买了一本《恐怖故事大合集（下卷）》的电子书（天啦噜怎么那时候的电子书还要钱）然后就上瘾了，到现在还记得那篇叫《槐树》的鬼故事，好惊悚。丹丁的小姑家有电脑，每次她用读卡器去下电子书的时候我都会拜托她给我找点恐怖小说，那一次她给我下了一部《冤鬼路五部曲》，是以大学为背景的校园恐怖小说开山之作，这个系列和我以前看过的小说都不一样，它不是单纯的无脑恐怖，它在校园传说的基础上增加了烧脑的推理环环相扣的细节和隐藏的感情线，有一种魔力让你一旦读起来就停不下来。我最喜欢第四部《魂祭》，星晨和林鸢茵，最意难平的一对。作者Tina的文笔我真的太喜欢了，一个字都不愿意跳过，我特意去找了她写过的所有小说，存在单独的文件夹里，可惜她现在不写小说了高中开始看黑色火种的灵异小说，蛮恐怖的，思路比较新颖，不过他交代的规则事宜之类太多了；当然也喜欢悬疑犯罪类小说，雷米的《心理罪》是最喜欢的一本。◾冬天窝在暖暖的被子里，夏天坐在窗台上，听雨声啃着桃子看Tina的小说；暑假吹着风扇靠着墙，吃着豆干喝着水，黑色火种的《地狱公寓》我能看一天；高三在宿舍小床上，开着昏暗的小台灯翻看《心理罪》能找到一本好看的小说真的是人生一大享受。◾配图是以前高中的小本子，正面摘抄反面记录生活（以前还会好好写字，现在的字都进化成草书了）
items.translation: #ShortEssay# "Memories + Fiction Chapter" ◾ The happiest time in junior high school at Chongwen was Friday. After enduring four morning classes and having a casual lunch, I would take my pocket money to the snack shop to buy things—those small snacks that cost 1 yuan per pack, and the three braised tofu sticks for 2.5 yuan per bag that I always bought. I also loved Eclairs back then. Returning to the classroom with my haul, I could take the school bus home in the afternoon. The school bus had two batches; I was in the second batch, so I could still do homework at school. The half-hour ride home felt quick. The bus TV played movies, music videos, and "Diors Man," but due to motion sickness, I usually just looked out the window and listened. Arriving home brought that long-lost feeling of home—the small living room had air different from the classroom. Turning on the TV, opening the drawer to power on my phone, the joy and comfort of returning home after a week were truly unforgettable. In the evening, I waited for my mom to come back, and we’d watch TV, chat, and eat snacks in another room. Monday mornings were painful; every time I woke up at night, I’d check my phone to see how many hours of sleep I had left before getting up. Going to school in winter meant waking up very early—4:30 a.m., when it was still dark. I’d take the earliest bus to school and the latest bus home. Sometimes, staring out the dark bus window, I’d imagine a female ghost in white suddenly rushing out from the roadside. The classroom was also dark; our considerate principal allowed early bus students to sleep there, but most classmates used that precious time to catch up on homework. ◾ In junior high, I started reading fiction. The school snack shop sold a fiction magazine called "Spark," which contained many short youth campus stories. I’d read the magazine at school and e-books on my phone at home. At the time, domineering CEO stories, gangster boyfriend tales, and school heartthrob novels were popular, but I only liked pure campus romance, and of course, horror fiction (Ha! items.original: 米夏上了车，我拚命的喘气，眼看前例已开，车头又被挡住了，这一回他们跑不了亲爱的孩子，试著也去分析父母和他们本身的问题，也试著去了解，你的那份学费和衣食是父母的血汗钱换来的，这么一想，养育之恩，我们都不能回报，又何忍对他们要求太多呢？　　往往，大部材中国的父母，将孩子当做命根，将孩子视为自己生命的延伸与继续，期望自己一生没能完成的理想和光荣，都能在孩子的身上实现最令人喜欢的是坐在火边的恩里格，他是西班牙北部比利牛斯山区来的，他头发最长，不但长还是卷的，面色红润，表情天真，他目不转睛的望著我，然后轻轻的喘口气，说∶“哇，你真像印地安女人我的生命在此时对我没有意义，唯一希望的是他们停止说话，给我永远的宁静，那怕是死也没有比这些声音在我肉体上的伤害更令我苦痛的了 萌妹纸米己聪的微博视频
items.translation: Misha got in the car, I gasped desperately. Seeing that a precedent had already been set and the front of the car was blocked again, this time they couldn't escape. Dear child, try to analyze your parents and their own problems too, and try to understand that your tuition and clothing are bought with your parents' sweat and blood. Thinking this way, we can never repay the grace of upbringing, so how can we bear to demand too much from them? Often, most Chinese parents treat their children as their lifeline, seeing them as an extension and continuation of their own lives, hoping that the ideals and glory they couldn't achieve in their lifetime can be realized through their children. The most likable one is Enrique sitting by the fire. He is from the Pyrenees mountains in northern Spain. He has the longest hair, not only long but also curly, with a rosy complexion and an innocent expression. He stared at me intently, then gently sighed and said, "Wow, you really look like an Indian woman." My life has no meaning to me at this moment; the only hope is that they stop talking and give me eternal peace. Even death is not more painful than the harm these sounds inflict on my flesh. Mengmeizhi Mijicong's Weibo video.

items.original: 很奇怪呀 只要一睡着就会梦见家里面 可是那天我也不想家 会有时候很委屈，感觉自己好无依无靠，这个陌生的地方，我要面对全都是陌生的人，其实已经有大半年没有接触过新的人了，具体说来不知道该怎么社交了，我真的很社恐呀，今年发生了一些不幸，也对我的生活造成了改变，但是选择了的东西是无法改变的，我现在需要做的就只是过好我现在的生活，以前老是想太多，导致失眠暴躁想自杀，想再想起来也好无奈，宣泄自己的情绪在社会平台上，现在看来真的很幼稚...今年真的改变了我许多，各个方面，看了几个月的心理医生，感觉想的太多跟以前不一样了，但是我现在还是迷茫的，会在意太多，我真的好敏感，一点点小的细节小事我都会放大它，并且独自伤心，每天夜晚都在哭每天失眠的日子熬过去了，现在还是挺开心的，有了新的朋友新的生活，我真的希望我能好好的 不让爸爸妈妈担心了
items.translation: It's very strange; whenever I fall asleep, I dream of home, but that day I wasn't even homesick. Sometimes I feel very wronged, as if I have no one to rely on. In this unfamiliar place, I have to face all unfamiliar people. Actually, it's been over half a year since I've met anyone new, and I don't really know how to socialize anymore. I'm really socially anxious. Some unfortunate things happened this year, which also changed my life, but what's chosen cannot be changed. What I need to do now is just live my current life well. I used to overthink, leading to insomnia, irritability, and thoughts of suicide. Looking back now, it feels so helpless. Venting my emotions on social platforms seems really childish now... This year has truly changed me a lot, in every aspect. After seeing a psychologist for a few months, I feel like my thinking is different from before, but I'm still lost. I care too much; I'm really sensitive. I magnify even the smallest details and get sad over them alone. I've gotten through the days of crying every night and insomnia. Now I'm quite happy, with new friends and a new life. I really hope I can be okay and not worry my parents anymore.

items.original: 经过了好一阵儿的梅雨季节🌧️终于迎来了短暂的几天放晴☀️阴天太容易让人抑郁➕犯困了我还记得 以前我跟我姐说 最喜欢的就是下雨天 开着暖光灯 吃着小胡鸭 看着剧 盖着小毯子现在一到下雨天就觉得 嗯 晚上可以睡个好觉了💤亲身经验证明 充足的睡眠+不熬夜=最好的养颜秘方当然了 认真护肤也是不能丢的好久不自pai  请你看高鼻梁 不要脸的亮亮任何时候 都不要因为任何事和人而放弃你的家人和朋友圈呀生活应该是丰富而充实的你可能不会知道 我也很忙 也有很多事情要做以前对于结婚没有什么特别的感觉现在慢慢长大 加上有接触到新娘跟妆这个行业化妆师真的是一个挺幸福的职业 每天接触着不同的新婚夫妇见证着他们美好的爱情 连自己的心情也会不自觉的变好虽然现在这个社会 对女性到年龄就要结婚 还是有褒贬不一但希望每个人都可以是因为爱而结婚虽然我的想法不能代表大多数人没有必须结婚的年龄 只有要结婚的爱情绝不将就 绝不委屈自己永远相信自己值得拥有最好的因为我就是最好的受fu蝶er的墙裂安利 我成功入了榴莲千层的坑儿越发不可收拾得赶快遏制住这种体重失常的苗头今晚打雷 也下雨 关窗 开空调希望睡个好觉💤晚安✨#晚安日记#
items.translation: After a long rainy season 🌧️, we finally have a few brief sunny days ☀️. Overcast weather easily makes people depressed and sleepy. I remember telling my sister before that my favorite thing was rainy days—turning on warm lights, eating Little Hu Duck, watching dramas, and snuggling under a small blanket. Now when it rains, I just think, well, I can sleep well tonight 💤. Personal experience proves that sufficient sleep + no staying up late = the best beauty secret. Of course, proper skincare shouldn’t be neglected either. Haven’t taken a selfie in a while, so here’s a shameless look at my high nose bridge, bright and bold. No matter what, never give up on your family and friends because of anything or anyone. Life should be rich and fulfilling. You might not know, but I’m also very busy and have lots to do. I didn’t have any special feelings about marriage before, but as I grow older and get involved in the bridal makeup industry, I realize being a makeup artist is such a happy job—meeting different newlywed couples every day, witnessing their beautiful love, and even my own mood unconsciously improves. Although society still has mixed opinions about women marrying at a certain age, I hope everyone can marry for love. My views may not represent the majority, but there’s no right age for marriage—only the right love for marriage. Never settle, never compromise yourself. Always believe you deserve the best, because I am the best. Strongly recommended by @fu_dieer, I’ve fallen into the durian mille-feuille pit and can’t stop—need to curb this weight-gain trend quickly. Thunder and rain tonight, closing windows and turning on the AC, hoping for a good sleep 💤. Goodnight ✨ #GoodnightDiary#

items.original: 我想还是写一段话吧、这已经是我第二次对喜欢的这个城市的一种怀疑了，第一次车子在市公安局斜对面车停马路划线内车窗被砸、时间2017年9🈷️、第二次本月2019年5🈷️16日下午在凉山出入境管理马路划线内停放、是属于职能收费、当我办完事后开车左边车子从后叶子板到前叶子板加前后车门被人用很尖锐的画很深的划痕、当找到收费员理论、结果被告知等公司来解决、后来西昌城投公司外包的智能收费公司片区管理来了报警、西昌市西郊派出所民警赶到现场后要求我和智能公司一同到派出所协商处理、到了派出所片区管理又喊了智能收费的公司两拔人来解决、可没有一个拿出实际的解决方案、都是推卸责任、就连派出所警官都告知对方，你们收费了就意味着你们达成了合同关系理应赔偿损失、可对方公司说让车主去找肇事的人、我一个车主那里去找肇事的人？也是是看到我们是川A的车子、能拖就拖反正他们也不急、也没有敢于承担责任的意愿、我想我自己也可以把我车子恢复如初、但是我还是想通过这样的事情让更多的人对西昌这个城市的管理提出意见、作为外地来游玩的游客本来是很开心的事、结果搞得心寒、其他没有划、就划了外地车牌的车子、我🈶️视频为证，西郊派出所警官很负责、可也没有办法对城投外包的公司处理、我们只有自认倒霉，我真诚的希望当地政府要对这样的外包公司进行监督管理！@央视新闻 @西昌城事 @爱凉山西昌 @成都商报 @封面新闻 @西昌都市报 @西昌公安 四川省·凉山彝族自治州 家驰连锁的微博视频
items.translation: I think I should write something. This is already the second time I've had doubts about this city I liked. The first time, in September 2017, my car was parked within the marked lines on the street opposite the Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the window was smashed. The second time was on the afternoon of May 16, 2019, in Liangshan. My car was parked within the marked lines on the street near the Exit-Entry Administration, which is a paid parking zone. After I finished my business and returned, I found deep, sharp scratches from the rear fender to the front fender and both doors on the left side of my car. When I argued with the parking attendant, I was told to wait for the company to resolve it. Later, the area manager from the smart parking company outsourced by Xichang City Investment Company arrived and called the police. Officers from Xichang Xijiao Police Station came and asked me and the smart company to go to the police station for negotiation. At the station, the area manager called two groups of people from the smart parking company to resolve the issue, but none offered a practical solution—they all shirked responsibility. Even the police officer told them that since they charged for parking, a contractual relationship was formed, and they should compensate for the damage. But the company said the car owner should find the perpetrator. How am I, as a car owner, supposed to find the perpetrator? Probably because they saw my car had a Sichuan A license plate, they drag their feet since they're in no hurry and have no willingness to take responsibility. I could restore my car to its original condition myself, but I want to use this incident to let more people voice their opinions about the management of Xichang City. As a tourist from out of town, it was supposed to be a happy trip, but it ended up being disheartening. Other cars weren't scratched—only the out-of-town license plate was targeted. I have video evidence. The officers at Xijiao Police Station were very responsible but couldn't do anything about the company outsourced by City Investment. We can only accept our bad luck. I sincerely hope the local government will supervise and manage such outsourced companies! @CCTV News @Xichang City Affairs @Love Liangshan Xichang @Chengdu Business Daily @Cover News @Xichang Metropolitan Daily @Xichang Police Sichuan Province · Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture Jiachi Chain

items.original: 今天我娃十个月了最近两周都没有更新辅食，也没有好好吃辅食。上周因为跟着奶奶在姨奶家，这周因为外公住院拆腿上的钢板我太累了从来没想过自己会闪婚，虽然是认识了八九年的朋友，也没想过结婚后会那么早要孩子，如果可以，我其实希望再过上一年二人世界再计划，就像《荼靡》里有句台词“我不要我的小孩是意外，不要他是妥协，是包袱，我要他是期待，是希望”但既然你来了妈妈也就做好准备成为一个妈妈，虽然我一直嚷嚷着我还没有玩够，还没有享受够自由从怀孕到你降生，妈妈也是满怀期待，去看去找去准备知识和物品，我认为我也是做好万全准备但事实上我还是手忙脚乱的，尤其是生完你后的这十个月，无力感一直存在。花自己的钱买奶粉买纸尿裤买玩具都要一一报备，好像以前那个风风火火，干脆利索的我不存在了，任性固执的我也不见了，我开始变的妥协，不断的理解，自我开解，这些都被总结为母爱大放光辉光辉，真的是这样么前年我爸受伤住院，躺在床上起不来我都没觉得这么累，今年仅仅小手术，我却觉得更累手术结束，我既要抱你又要推床，往返医院安全座椅哭闹不坐，挣扎着拽着我头发要来我怀里，没办法我只能骑摩托车，又担心你在医院抵抗力差把你留在家里，给你还不到12岁的舅舅看，送饭回来听他讲你找不到我哭的多惨前天午休，在床上看你玩着玩着我睡着了结果你掉床了，还好没摔倒哪里，把我心疼坏了，今晚在姨奶家，你又从沙发上摔了下去额头磕个包，妈妈心都要碎了，一闭眼就是你一遍一遍的摔下沙发，实在睡不下起来写写我要改变，为了你我也不会再妥协忍让了，以后我们过有质量的生活，不需要考虑太多，你有权利享受妈妈给予你的爱，妈妈也仅仅希望你衣食无忧，快乐健康成长，在爱，满足，包容，勇气中成长，十个月快乐王肉肉小盆友！（图为我回家做饭，回来我弟自豪的告诉我他自己晃悠了20多分钟哄睡的）我弟长大了
items.translation: My baby is ten months old today. I haven't updated about solid foods in the past two weeks, and he hasn't been eating them well either. Last week was because we were at my aunt's with grandma, and this week I'm exhausted because grandpa was hospitalized to have the steel plate in his leg removed. I never thought I'd have a whirlwind marriage, even though we were friends for eight or nine years, and I never thought we'd have a child so soon after marrying. If possible, I actually wished for another year of just the two of us before planning, like a line from the drama "Life Plan A and B": "I don't want my child to be an accident, a compromise, a burden. I want him to be an expectation, a hope." But since you came, Mom prepared herself to become a mother. Even though I kept saying I hadn't played enough, hadn't enjoyed enough freedom, from pregnancy to your birth, I was also full of anticipation, seeking out knowledge and preparing items. I thought I was fully prepared, but in reality, I've been scrambling, especially these past ten months since you were born. A sense of helplessness has been constant. Spending my own money on formula, diapers, toys requires reporting every item, as if the decisive, efficient me from before no longer exists. The willful, stubborn me is gone too. I've started to compromise, constantly understanding, consoling myself. All this gets summed up as maternal love shining brightly. Is it really like that? The year before last when my dad was injured and hospitalized, bedridden, I didn't feel this tired. This year, even with a minor surgery, I feel more exhausted. After the surgery, I had to hold you while pushing the bed. You cried and refused the car seat back and forth to the hospital, struggling, pulling my hair, wanting to be in my arms. I had no choice but to ride the motorcycle. I worried about your weaker immunity at the hospital, so I left you at home with your uncle who's not even 12 yet. Coming back from delivering food, I heard him describe how miserably you cried when you couldn't find me. The day before yesterday during a nap, I fell asleep watching you play on the bed, and you fell off. Luckily you didn't get hurt, but it broke my heart. Tonight at my aunt's, you fell off the sofa again and got a bump on your forehead. Mom

items.original: 早安 每个人的成长，都需要时间沉淀。很多人不愿意努力和付出，因为觉得短时间看不到回报，可你是否知道，每一次成长，都可能在未来的某个节点，让你成为更耀眼夺目的自己。命运从不会辜负每一个用力奔跑的人，所有的光芒，最终都会被看见！人生最要紧的，不是你站在什么地方，而是你要朝什么方向走！有梦想，才会有希望，有希望，才会有未来！
items.translation: Good morning. Everyone's growth requires time to settle. Many people are unwilling to work hard and give because they feel they don't see returns in a short time, but do you know that every bit of growth may, at some future point, make you a more dazzling version of yourself. Fate never lets down anyone who runs hard; all the radiance will eventually be seen! What matters most in life is not where you stand, but the direction you are heading! With dreams, there is hope; with hope, there is a future!

items.original: 我愿意一辈子陪你笑，陪你闹，陪你哭，陪你疯。我愿意一起变老，直到牙齿掉光的时候，还能穿着花裙子在床上聊八卦。如果有一天，你心动了，恋爱了，我不会说什么，只会把祝福送给你；如果有一天，你受伤了，疲倦了，我还是不会说什么，只会把肩膀借给你靠。                      ——致我亲爱的闺蜜
items.translation: I am willing to spend a lifetime laughing with you, playing with you, crying with you, and being crazy with you. I am willing to grow old together, until our teeth fall out, still able to wear floral dresses and gossip on the bed. If one day, you feel a flutter, you fall in love, I won't say anything, I will only give you my blessings; if one day, you are hurt, you are tired, I still won't say anything, I will only lend you my shoulder to lean on. — To my dear best friend

items.translation: ▹Being in a foreign land easily brings the sickness of parting sorrow; even the most wonderful medicine can hardly heal a heartbroken person. ▹2018.1.27 Third day home, first day check-in ▹Probably suffered too much from staying up late at school; since coming home I've just been sleeping and sleeping, caught a bad cold at night. Every time I rush to a new city and struggle to adjust, I end up getting sick. Not much time left for my thesis; training starts in March, need to keep that in mind. Have to finish writing the thesis in one month. ▹Bought a bunch of drinks, brought the teapot to bed because it's just too cold, reading in bed, brewing various teas and coffee, sneezing, dozing off, and reading the thesis all at once. Need to write tomorrow, otherwise I'll have to eat a whole tube of wasabi. Ji'an

items.original: 太可怕了！！！！19-27号这九天在外面 不需要住酒店（住姐姐家）只是吃饭和在外面溜达 关键是也没买什么东西 也没玩什么东西 我居然花了1047元（其中高铁票85 火锅155 烧烤123 风衣185）剩下的支出单项最多不超过40 我震惊了 我在学校的时候每一笔钱都记账一块钱的也记  我都知道钱花在哪了 这下了好了 回家以后就没记过  看到之前的余额和现在的我直接懵了 完全不知道钱花哪了 哭了呀 从现在起我每一笔都要记账了  太可怕了简直#记账##我的钱花哪了#
items.translation: So terrifying!!!! For these nine days from the 19th to the 27th, I was out and didn't need to stay at a hotel (stayed at my sister's place), just ate and wandered around. The key point is I didn't buy much or do much, yet I actually spent 1,047 yuan (including high-speed rail ticket 85, hot pot 155, barbecue 123, trench coat 185). The remaining individual expenses were no more than 40 each. I'm shocked. When I was at school, I tracked every single expense, even one yuan, so I knew exactly where my money went. Now, after coming home, I stopped tracking. Seeing my previous balance and now, I'm completely baffled, totally clueless where the money went. Crying. From now on, I'm tracking every single expense again. So terrifying, absolutely. #Budgeting #WhereDidMyMoneyGo

items.translation: I saw my brother's shadow, that biological brother five years older than me. We don't even exchange ten words a year. Sometimes our parents intentionally try to gather everyone together, but it always ends with everyone dispersing because they can't stand the awkwardness. Deep down, I really long for warmth from family. We all know the reasons why things have developed to this point. Some things cannot be recovered or changed. What I remember most clearly is my brother saying to my dad, "Dad, stop trying to force the relationship between me and Jianxue. If you and mom are gone, I won't have any contact with her anymore. That's it."

items.translation: My waking time is getting earlier and earlier with depression. I don't dare to increase quetiapine to two pills, as I've heard quitting medication is a very painful process. I'm probably already addicted to quetiapine and clonazepam. What's more frightening is that I'm starting to develop a bit of tolerance, and my mind has also become dependent on the medication. I can't increase the dosage anymore, it's truly helpless. I've heard clonazepam is the strongest benzodiazepine; others find 1/4 of a pill effective, but I need a whole pill, and its effect diminishes rapidly.

items.original: #美妆必buy品#油痘肌成分党的修复＋护肤秘诀！ 变成了研究僧，需要长时间埋在实验室里，可能压力太大了，痘痘经常爆发😭就算消下去了还有痘印存在！精致的女孩，不仅要科研做的6，护肤更是不能停！（如果皮肤状态不好，我就会一整天兴致都不高😭）因为是用在脸上的，所以也是发挥了研究生的精神，从品牌、成分到使用效果，严格把关，最终脱颖而出的强大胜利者哦，修复能力很nice的创尔美修护面膜和小魔瓶‼️其实我是看到吉克隽逸，我女神的同款‼️才下定决心买的，哈哈哈面膜的话，我一般是在晚上用，它的主要成分很简单，就是水和胶原，也没有其他添加剂，对敏感肌肤是很友好的。而且因为没添加增稠剂，它的精华就很稀。这个品牌的生产标准都是按GMP来的，再加上它有经过特殊辐照处理的，可以直接敷贴在受损肌肤上，和平常的面膜不一样！就算长痘痘了，也敢大胆放心的敷啦~为了避免拿出来面膜时，精华液流出，我每次都先捏一捏，把多余的精华液先挤到袋里！然后敷了一会，感觉吸收差不多了，再把袋里剩余的精华涂抹上去，所以它的使用时间要长点，需要敷个20分钟。我虽然是油皮，但是仍然觉得敷完以后特别清爽❗️它都不需要清洗的，可以直接涂抹水乳，很省事啊！嘻嘻…⚠️友情提示：现在秋冬季节，皮肤偏干，做完面膜之后，一定要再进行正常护肤顺序，擦上水、精华、乳、面霜等护肤品，这样才能把水份锁进皮肤~达到长效的保湿功能~💕水乳可以选择呼吸，我说过很多次，很nice～虽然现在是秋天，但是美白防晒还是不能停‼️今天宋轶小姐姐因为白还上了热搜～⚠️不管春夏秋冬，阴雨晴天，都要擦隔离防晒霜！！！紫外线强的时候还要穿防晒衣，带遮阳伞~ 充分做好物理防晒另外像我很喜欢吃含VC食物~比如小黄瓜、西红柿等~食物所含的VC也能有效帮助黑色素还原，帮助人体维持白皙状态~我在买面膜的时候还加了它家的小魔瓶修护原液，想把下巴的暗沉给救回来～淡化痘印。小魔瓶我一般是晚上敷完面膜以后再滴在脸上，来帮助吸收后续的产品。面膜我用了2盒了，现在脸上的痘已经不是很严重了，不细看几乎看不出来了～🙈看着比以前舒服了好多。总之，希望秋冬你萌一样也很美💕 绿洲 #潮流种草季#
items.translation: #MustBuyBeautyProducts# Repair + Skincare Secrets for Oily, Acne-Prone Skin Ingredient Enthusiasts! I've become a research student, needing to bury myself in the lab for long hours, probably due to too much stress, acne often flares up 😭 Even after it subsides, acne marks remain! A refined girl not only needs to excel in research but also must never stop skincare! (If my skin condition is poor, my mood stays low all day 😭) Since it's for the face, I've applied my graduate student spirit, strictly vetting everything from brand and ingredients to effectiveness, and the ultimate standout winners are the powerful Chuangermei Repair Mask and the Little Magic Bottle with excellent repair capabilities‼️ Actually, I saw that Jike Junyi, my goddess, uses the same products‼️ That's what really made me decide to buy them, hahaha. For the mask, I usually use it at night. Its main ingredients are simple—just water and collagen—with no other additives, making it very friendly for sensitive skin. Also, because no thickeners are added, its essence is quite thin. This brand's production standards follow GMP, and it undergoes special irradiation treatment, so it can be applied directly to damaged skin, unlike regular masks! Even if I have acne, I can apply it boldly and without worry~ To avoid essence spilling when taking out the mask, I always squeeze the packet first to push excess essence into the corner! Then, after applying it for a while and feeling it's mostly absorbed, I apply the remaining essence from the packet, so its usage time is longer, needing about 20 minutes. Even though I have oily skin, I still find it particularly refreshing after use❗️ It doesn't need rinsing; you can directly apply toner and lotion, so convenient! Hehe... ⚠️ Friendly reminder: Now in autumn and winter, when skin tends to be drier, after using the mask, be sure to follow the normal skincare routine, applying toner, essence, lotion, cream, etc., to lock moisture into the skin~ achieving long-lasting hydration~ 💕 For toner and lotion, you can choose Su:m37°, I've said it many times, it's great~ Although it's autumn, whitening and sun protection still can't stop‼️ Today, Song Yi made it to trending searches because of her fair skin~ ⚠️ Regardless of spring,

items.translation: So sleepy, yet my heart feels full. I'm truly someone who overthinks a lot, understands many things, yet lives without clarity, always giving others perfect advice while my own life is already riddled with holes. We are all giants in words, dwarfs in action. Still, we must live in the way most comfortable for ourselves, manage ourselves well, maintain moderation in all things, and remind ourselves to be cautious in speech and action. I'm not very good at comforting others, but I always hope they'll tell me when something happens. Even if I can't do anything, I think I can be a very good listener, but I sincerely hope they never experience anything bad and can remain children forever.

We were always together at school before and never really argued about anything, but after starting the long-distance relationship, it hasn't been going well. I get triggered easily; my temper really isn't great. Thankfully, through all the big and small arguments, he has been tolerant of me. items.original: 很多时候，我也搞不明白我自己，我明明是那种什么玩笑都开的起的人，有时候却因为一句特别不起眼的话，别扭好几天。我明明不是那种很爱计较的人，但我的确会因为一件很小很小的事斤斤计较，导致关系崩裂。我觉得我是一个意志很坚定心态挺好的人，却也会被别人的质疑别人的三言两语所左右。我明明知道说出某些话会伤害别人，却还是说了，我明明知道我这么做会后悔，却还是做了。说实话，我已经过够了这种日子，看够了这样的自己，没办法，除了硬挺着别无选择，硬挺着接受突然的变脆弱，突然的不快乐，突然的被某个细节揪住，突然的那种沉默不想说话，把事情都放在回忆里，被时间磨成水放在心里，再从眼睛里流出来。这是我最强大的地方，也是我最软弱的地方……抑郁症#带着边框一起拍##天气即天意#
items.translation: Often, I don't understand myself either. I'm clearly the type who can take any joke, yet sometimes I get hung up for days over a particularly insignificant remark. I'm clearly not the type who loves to nitpick, but I do indeed fixate on a very, very small thing, leading to broken relationships. I think I'm a person with very firm willpower and a pretty good mindset, yet I can also be swayed by others' doubts, by their few casual words. I clearly know that saying certain things will hurt others, but I still say them; I clearly know I'll regret doing this, but I still do it. To be honest, I've had enough of this kind of life, seen enough of this version of myself. There's no other way; besides toughing it out, there's no choice. Toughing it out through suddenly becoming fragile, suddenly becoming unhappy, suddenly being caught by some detail, suddenly falling into that silence where I don't want to speak, putting everything into memories, letting time grind them into water placed in my heart, only to flow out from my eyes. This is my strongest point, and also my weakest point... Depression #TakeAPictureWithTheFrame# #WeatherIsDestiny#

items.original: 当你和某人建立起亲密的关系，你就会用那个人来填补你的洞，一旦那个人死亡或是关系结束了，你不会感觉失去了那个人，你感受到的是填补坑洞的东西不见了，感受丧失了自己的一部分。因为以前被他填满的洞现在又暴露出来了，这就是你会那么痛苦的原因。——《秘密副作用》李欣频#打卡日记##每日分享#
items.translation: When you establish an intimate relationship with someone, you use that person to fill your void. Once that person dies or the relationship ends, you don't feel like you've lost that person; you feel that the thing filling the void is gone, experiencing the loss of a part of yourself. Because the void that was once filled by them is now exposed again, which is why you feel so much pain. — "The Secret Side Effect" by Li Xinpin #Check-in Diary# #Daily Share#

items.original: 晕 这疫情真把我这一年计划都耽误了。且不说开学要期末考试，初会考试说不定还得和期末重起来考试资料都在学校啥也没学还不给退费，九月份初和中旬也有考试，到现在还没联系导师写学年论文  真的很忙，计划是要在准备考研前把所有的考试都结束 。我尽量在最短的时间内把所有的事情安排并做到不留遗憾，虽然可能结果不会那么好，但也不会比现在更差了。
items.translation: Ugh, this pandemic has really messed up my plans for the whole year. Not to mention having final exams right when school starts, the preliminary accounting exam might even clash with finals, all my study materials are at school and I haven't learned anything yet with no refunds, there are also exams in early and mid-September, and I still haven't contacted my advisor to write my annual thesis. I'm really busy; the plan was to finish all exams before preparing for the postgraduate entrance exam. I'll try to arrange everything in the shortest time and do it without regrets, although the results might not be great, they probably can't get worse than now.

items.translation: Should insulin pens be refrigerated in summer? Many diabetic patients require long-term insulin injections, and insulin pens were designed for convenient self-injection. items.original: 虽然人生还很长，但我的人生能做的到的事太少了，看到网上很多游玩，旅行，见识很多的事都在比我年轻的时候，自己却还得挣钱，真的有那么一天的话，我希望我这辈子想做却没有做到的事，下辈子能做到，现在这种发自内心的社会底层思想能没有，想要有钱，不求多有钱，但不想在这种环境下活着，什么都没有什么都做不到，努力也还是无力，无法改变，随波逐流，真的羡慕那些要么家里有钱，要么有能力，不是母亲六岁就走掉，父亲在家10多年不工作好吃懒做的家庭。如果有下辈子，我希望我能不用这么辛苦和累，而且就算这样却还是改变不了什么。
items.translation: Although life is still long, there are too few things I can actually do in my life. I see many people online traveling, sightseeing, and experiencing many things at a younger age than me, while I still have to earn money. If there really is such a day, I hope that the things I wanted to do in this lifetime but couldn’t achieve can be done in the next life, and that this deep-seated lower-class mentality can disappear. I want to have money—not necessarily a lot, but I don’t want to live in this kind of environment, where I have nothing and can do nothing, where even effort feels powerless, where nothing changes, and I just go with the flow. I really envy those who either come from wealthy families or have the ability, not from a family where my mother left when I was six and my father stayed home for over ten years without working, lazy and gluttonous. If there is a next life, I hope I don’t have to work so hard and suffer so much, and even then, it still changes nothing.

items.translation: When people first meet, they always unconsciously show their best and kindest side, feeling like they should have met sooner. But as they become more familiar and more real with each other, many flaws become apparent. So you often hear others say "you've changed" or "I didn't expect you to be like this." I used to want to explain myself, but later I stopped paying attention to such labels. The right people won't leave; whether in friendship or love, time will always leave you with the truest ones. "Time will reveal everything."

items.translation: "Love alone is not enough for two people to be together." If he can't give you the care you want, if he can't provide you with enough sense of security, even if you love each other, you will eventually separate. Thanks to my best friend for teaching me a lesson with her own painful experience—love is actually not as rare and hard to find as it seems, and how to make love last is the real test. Now, I don't really want to touch upon relationships anymore. I always feel that people who love each other will meet again at a suitable time, place, and with good weather.

items.original: 永远不要指望别人对你的痛苦感同身受，你生不如死也好，你痛不欲生也罢，都只是你一个人的事情而已。即便是获取了别人的同情，里面也有可能包含了怜悯与敷衍这类的轻薄情绪，你又如何能指望别人解救你于水火之中呢，如果这痛苦不能让你变得愈加坚强，这痛苦来的又有何意义。
items.translation: Never expect others to empathize with your pain; whether you are living a life worse than death or suffering unbearably, it is solely your own affair. Even if you gain others' sympathy, it may contain shallow emotions like pity and perfunctoriness, so how can you expect others to rescue you from dire straits? If this pain does not make you stronger, what meaning does its arrival hold?

items.original: 下午给我妈打电话，她说要知足常乐。不是不知足，工作给我的远远超出我所创造的，可以称作是平步青云。可是越来越不快乐，总觉得生活是由诸多细胞构成的，除了工作外还应该有爱情，读书，交际等等，但是工作如癌细胞般不断增殖形成恶性肿瘤，而作为宿主我的养分有限，这意味着别的细胞正日益衰竭。
items.translation: I called my mom this afternoon, and she said I should be content and happy. It's not that I'm not content; my job has given me far more than I've created, you could call it a meteoric rise. But I'm becoming less and less happy. I always feel that life is made up of many cells; besides work, there should be love, reading, socializing, etc. But work keeps proliferating like cancer cells, forming a malignant tumor, and as the host, my nutrients are limited, which means other cells are gradually failing.

items.original: ［艺术咖］@蓬皮杜中心 之神仙眷侣温柔包裹    F爸爸和Z妈妈拿下跨学科人文艺术项目网页链接 ，需要吸收大量养分。视频《2分钟了解蓬皮杜大地艺术展》网页链接 就是课程之一。谢谢官V的转发，么么哒。今天加更12张图，从另一个角度来看展。    以下内容偏“工作思考日记”，如果想了解这场展览本身，艺术大V@-康定斯基的蛋-  发了一篇可读性很高的文 网页链接 谢谢被我高颜值蛋翻牌了，么么哒。.    还记得@克莱尔酱酱酱  带Z妈VIP看波尔坦斯基Christian Boltanski的展时，我俩被布展之精细缜密而震撼，惊呼OMG的次数绝对不亚于直播间的李佳琦。对，这就是蓬皮杜。无论什么展，空间设计、导览单、展签、灯光、展箱、定做的展墙、定做的画框、整体色调、放映空间、LED屏幕墙嵌入，没毛病。无论是三联画就用一面墙的培根Francis Bacon，还是尺寸各异材料称奇的杰夫·昆斯Jeff Koons，只要回顾展放在蓬皮杜，布展的“气”就是顺的。    这么多年来，唯一一次看到审美疲劳的展归吉亚科梅蒂Alberto Giacometti。是自己的原因，当时太年轻，还没走上艺术史教师的路。近几年能明显感受到蓬皮杜在调和重公共教育信息量，还是重观众体验舒适度，作出的尝试和努力。    “克里斯托与珍妮-克劳德: 巴黎！” 双人展的信息量&舒适感都兼顾到。蓬皮杜出手，作品数量是基本配备。在此基础上，时间线、主题区域、大招压轴，环环相扣。影像资料的辅助作用的度拿捏的非常精妙。大爱包裹新桥项目的卷宗档案，玲琅满目全被定制无反光框包裹起来。这个俏皮的无声文字游戏，着实法式浪漫。    展厅里用到很多墙面挖空设计，或是透明玻璃相隔设计，你看作品时，看同样作品的别人，同时也在看你。这种视觉搭脑回路不经意的期许碰撞，好啦好啦，Z妈妈承认，被甜到了。    最后，感叹爱了爱了学建筑设计出身的人儿。那些在图纸上手绘一丝不苟的线条，密密麻麻的数据和标示，强迫症重患表示极度舒适。.PS：亲子业务，蓬皮杜也很可：网页链接 妈妈带你看展览。.#艺术# #展览# #蓬皮杜中心# #遇见艺术# #带你看展览# #巴黎# #云看展# #带着微博看展览# #约会博物馆# #zafinparis#
items.translation: [Art Aficionado] @Centre Pompidou's divine couple gently wrapped. The video "Understand the Pompidou Land Art Exhibition in 2 Minutes" webpage link is one of the courses. Thanks official V for reposting, mwah mwah. If you want to understand this exhibition itself, art influencer @-Kandinsky's Egg- posted a highly readable article webpage link. Thanks for being noticed by my high-value egg, mwah mwah. Remember when @Claire Jiangjiangjiang took Z Mom for a VIP viewing of Christian Boltanski's exhibition, we were both shocked by the meticulous and thorough exhibition design, exclaiming OMG no less than Li Jiaqi during a live stream. Yes, this is the Pompidou. Regardless of the exhibition, the spatial design, guide sheets, exhibition labels, lighting, display cases, custom exhibition walls, custom frames, overall color scheme, screening spaces, embedded LED screen walls—flawless. Whether it's Francis Bacon's triptych using one wall or Jeff Koons' works of varying sizes and surprising materials, as long as the retrospective is held at the Pompidou, the exhibition's "energy" flows smoothly. Over the years, the only exhibition that caused aesthetic fatigue was Alberto Giacometti's. It was my own fault; I was too young then, not yet on the path to becoming an art history teacher. In recent years, one can clearly feel the Pompidou's attempts and efforts to balance emphasizing public educational information versus prioritizing audience comfort. The duo exhibition "Christo and Jeanne-Claude: Paris!" balances both information & comfort. When the Pompidou handles it, the number of works is a basic provision. On this foundation, the timeline, thematic zones, and grand finale are interlinked. The auxiliary role of video materials is measured very precisely. Love the dossier archives of the wrapped Pont Neuf project, all琳琅满目 (glittering) and encased in custom non-reflective frames. This playful, silent word game is truly French romantic. The exhibition hall uses many designs with hollowed-out walls or transparent glass separations. When you look at the works, you see others viewing the same works, and they also see you. items.translation: It's really strange. From childhood, people are taught to look for problems within themselves, not to shirk responsibility, and are always asked, "Why are you like this when others aren't?" Gradually, an unconfident personality is built. When grown up, it's easy to blame oneself for everything. Only then do you learn that the psychological method to heal an unconfident personality is to not always blame yourself but to consider objective factors more. So contradictory. It even feels a bit tragic.

items.translation: Fairy tales only say Cinderella and the prince lived happily ever after, but no one delves into how humble that happiness is. No one asks if Cinderella is willing—as if as long as her foot fits into the glass slipper, she should be tearfully grateful and follow the prince back to the palace, then forever live in happiness with constant fear and trepidation. Without his rescue, she would still be washing clothes by the cold river. But what if Cinderella met a fisherman? They fall in love, she escapes her stepmother’s housework, and stays with him. Then there would be no Cinderella in the world, only a princess forever cherished in a fisherman’s heart.

items.original: #正能量# #腋臭狐臭# #狐臭怎么办#    随手传递正能量，一起寻找身边带来感动的瞬间。关爱身边的狐臭朋友，不要让悲剧发生在我们身边。[伴我同行]我叫曼曼，因为狐臭，曾经任性的我埋怨爹妈，好的不遗传，偏偏遗传这个招人烦的毛病，经常一家人闹得不愉快！也许真的有否极泰来这一说，那么难治疗的狐臭因为一次偶然机会得到老师微信22352625，通过她的指导竟然痊愈了。在这把这段神奇的经历分享给大家，有困扰的“狐友”可以了解下我大学时冬天谈的男朋友，到夏天的时候就分手了，理由是我有狐臭。我想，自己的狐臭不去，大概会孤独一辈子吧？于是，我开始喷味道很浓烈的香水，以此来掩盖身上的异味。大学时候没什么钱，贵的买不起，劣质的经常把自己和一屋子室友熏得晕晕乎乎的。我也曾尝试了各种祛除狐臭的方法，割除，食疗，各种稀奇古怪的方法我都用过，不仅不管用，腋下还发红发痒，真的是把我折腾的要死。后来，到了毕业季，我面试好几家公司，一进去都看到面试官们在邹眉头，捂鼻子。和别人都聊好长时间，轮到我的时候，几分钟就把我打发了。我想，去狐臭这个事儿不能再等了，得赶紧行动。于是我开始在网上各种搜寻有关祛除狐臭的咨询，终于功夫不负有心人，我结识了一位老师，添加了她的微信号22352625.她耐心仔细的给我指出我做错的地方，并且给了我专业的指导，两个月的时间，我的狐臭彻底消除了，我也成功的找了一份很不错的工作。希望被狐臭困扰的你也能早日祛除狐臭，让自己的生活回到正轨上。
items.translation: #PositiveEnergy# #BodyOdor# #HowToDealWithBodyOdor# Spread positive energy and look for touching moments around us. Show care for friends with body odor, don't let tragedy happen around us. [Accompany Me] My name is Manman. Because of body odor, I used to blame my parents—why didn't they pass on good traits, but this annoying problem instead? It often caused family conflicts. Maybe there's truth in "after extreme bad luck comes good luck." This hard-to-treat body odor was cured by chance after I got a teacher's WeChat 22352625 and followed her guidance. I'm sharing this magical experience here. Troubled "body odor friends" can learn from it. In college, I had a boyfriend in winter, but we broke up in summer because of my body odor. I thought if I didn't get rid of it, I might be lonely forever. So, I started spraying strong perfume to cover the smell. In college, I had little money—couldn't afford expensive ones, and cheap ones often made me and my roommates dizzy. I tried various methods to remove body odor: surgery, diet, all sorts of weird ways. Not only useless, but my armpits also turned red and itchy. It really tortured me. Later, during graduation season, I interviewed at several companies. Each time, I saw interviewers frowning and covering their noses. They talked to others for a long time, but with me, it was just a few minutes. I thought I couldn't wait any longer—had to act fast. So I searched online for body odor removal advice. Finally, effort paid off: I met a teacher and added her WeChat 22352625. She patiently pointed out my mistakes and gave professional guidance. In two months, my body odor was completely gone, and I successfully landed a good job. I hope those troubled by body odor can also remove it soon and get life back on track.

items.original: 奶柚无敌#毕竟是柚子同人文# 【小白X柚子】你一根我一根，咦，怎么只有一根辣条了？（一）        想写狗柚子的同人文好久了，这篇文是块小甜饼呀。请大家多多支持呀！不定期更新，看我心情，不过应该是个小短篇，白柚大军，给我站起来！！！ 文案：电竞文，ABO设定 最强阿珂柚子X国服韩信小白 并不王者的王者文。前方注意！十分沙雕。         柚子是这两年在斗鱼直播上凭借一手戳屁股能手的刺客阿珂爆红的王者荣耀主播，也是现在活跃在一线的主播中少有的omega。        王者荣耀是最近比较热门的一款团队竞技类游戏，在游戏中，柚子主要操作的是打野这个位置的英雄。第一次直播柚子打的是雅典娜，是个死亡后在峡谷上空飘着盯着队友，给队友增加鸭梨的英雄，对于操作的要求还是蛮高的，需要满脑子的献祭想法。        简直是玛丽苏男主的标配好嘛，我弄不死你我就去死！        柚子并不是职业玩家出身，简单点说吧，职业队里的教练嫌他吃太多了，把他扔出来了，所以没上的了职业战场。第一次直播他的水平其实在其他主播看来不算好，还需要再磨练一下，但是长得又圆，又有说垃圾话的天赋，比如，小老弟，你怎么肥似，天生就是吃这碗饭的料。       一张圆润的脸庞怼着镜头，小小的眼睛紧紧盯着你，话都不用说，小姐姐们就都忍不住捂住心口开始大声嚎哭：胖柚子！！！木由子！！！爸爸爱你！！！        第一次直播后，柚子被一个浑身发着闪光的小戴姐姐看上，参加了一场由斗鱼举办的DSF比赛，只能在斗鱼直播上看见的小比赛。比赛里，他担任的是ADC的位置，传说中的太阳落山了的后裔。        凭借这场比赛，柚子也被斗鱼发现了稍许的潜力，虽然不算一飞冲天但也能说算是主播途坦荡？了。        柚子本来是传媒大学新闻系的学生，结果还没等他开始做新闻，自己先变成新闻了。        因为前几次的游戏直播的人设都比较逗比，不过还有出彩的部分，比如说拿刺客打野，恰好柚子最近找到了一个适合他的戳屁股的英雄——阿珂，按狗柚子的话来说，从背后戳，百分百暴击的最适合他这个脸黑的人了，所以经济公司就干脆给他艹了一个最强戳屁股能手的人设。柚子自己都觉得这狗屁人设实在过分沙雕，但是，生活不易，忍了。        不知道现在的小姑娘是梦回一九八八还是怎么的，这种走沙雕路线穿品如衣服的人设，竟然从一群小奶狗小狼狗老干部中脱颖而出，意外的吃香。        柚子不太爱在社交软件上说话，所以他的微博大部分时间都不是自己打理。如果他的原创微博出现了“爱你们~”一类的字样，还配上了自拍，那多半是经纪人姐姐又上线了。评论区里都是一水的：小戴姐姐辛苦了！经纪人姐姐又帮忙来发微博了！小戴姐姐以后能悄悄拍一下狗柚子的胖脸凑个九宫格吗？好久不见了，甚是想念。        但是如果只有一句“钵钵鸡们，我来了”这几个字，粉丝们就知道是柚子上线了。        柚子自己也不知道为什么他比那些Alpha主播更圈粉，自己在老爹老娘面前就是三棍子，不五棍子打不出来一个闷屁的性格。         每次参加斗鱼举办的活动的时候都是假笑的站在那里神游，被其他人提醒后才反应过来应两句：嗯嗯嗯，对对对，就是这样，你说的太棒了！后来一度被钵钵鸡们嘲笑是在幻想自己是阿珂疯狂想戳主持人嗯嗯。         其实他内心没有这么污的，他只是不知道在台上干什么，放不开。然后得了一个活动黑人的标签。归根结底，大概是他这个大脸盘子甚是让小姐姐们喜爱的缘故吧。

Irregular updates, depends on my mood, but it should be a short story. Bai-You army, stand up!!! Synopsis: Esports story, ABO setting, strongest Ah Ke Yuzu X national server Han Xin Xiao Bai. A not-so-kingly kingly story. Heads up! Very silly. Yuzu is a Honor of Kings streamer who blew up on Douyu over the past two years thanks to his skill as a backstabbing assassin Ah Ke, and is also one of the few omega among currently active top streamers. Honor of Kings is a recently popular team competitive game. In the game, Yuzu mainly plays heroes in the jungle role. For his first stream, Yuzu played Athena, a hero who floats above the map after death staring at teammates, increasing their pressure. The skill requirement is quite high, needing a mind full of sacrificial ideas. It's practically the standard setup for a Mary Sue male lead, alright? If I can't kill you, I'll die! Yuzu isn't from a professional player background. To put it simply, the coach on the pro team thought he ate too much and kicked him out, so he never made it to the pro scene. His skill level during his first stream actually wasn't considered good by other streamers' standards and needed more polishing, but he has a round face and a talent for trash talk, like, "Little bro, what's up with you?" He's naturally cut out for this job. A plump face shoved into the camera, tiny eyes staring right at you, without even saying a word, the girls couldn't help but cover their hearts and start wailing: Fat Yuzu!!! Mu You Zi!!! Daddy loves you!!! After his first stream, Yuzu was noticed by a sparkling Sister Xiao Dai and participated in a DSF competition hosted by Douyu, a small tournament only visible on Douyu. items.translation: While browsing Bilibili, I saw an interview with Zu'e: "What's your view on marketing accounts?" "They're just trying to survive, they have to write whatever gets attention, we should understand each other." Clarification posts get comments from people posing as casual onlookers saying "stop whitewashing," and I'm like: ????? What is whitewashing? Marketing accounts spread dirt to make money, writing malicious articles fabricating things out of thin air—out of so many professions, they choose this one, using just a few words to drag others into a whirlpool of public opinion. The helplessness of doing it for a living—that's what deserves whitewashing!! Liking someone who has a boyfriend/girlfriend, a family, kids, being a homewrecker who intrudes on others' relationships, justifying it with "just because I like them"—that's whitewashing!! Nowadays, people join online mobs and call themselves "snowflakes bravely charging ahead," turn on idols they used to fan or act as fair-weather critics with hindsight like "time-traveling police" saying "he's actually that kind of person"—why give yourselves such nice labels when your words are so filthy.... And those demanding apologies.... Why should people apologize for things they didn't do? Even if they apologize, would those mouths ever shut? Some people are just too idle. The malice of marketing accounts is disgusting.

items.translation: The Dadaadi market has closed down. Yesterday was its last day of operation. I didn't have any special attachment to it, yet I feel a faint sense of loss. items.translation: Recently I dug out the letter my mom wrote to me on my 18th birthday in 2018. I had gone out drinking that day and came back drunk, so I didn’t read it until the next day. Then, when a variety show mentioned the meaning of letters, I remembered it and took it out to read again. I feel my mindset has changed a lot. Back then, I thought my mom was just complaining about me being unfocused or something—she used to say that a lot, so I was really sensitive about it. But now, reading it again, that feeling is gone. Two years have passed in a blink, and I’ve grown up a bit more. I feel my mom has become more tolerant toward me, maybe because she thinks I won’t be by her side much longer. And here I am, carefree, still asking her every day to help me find a boyfriend! I’ve also changed a lot toward her—I never let arguments linger overnight anymore! I’m rambling so much! I’ll talk more next time. I’m sleepy now hahahaha.

items.translation: #Shi Manman's Braces Diary# Ninth follow-up appointment: The bracket on that tooth on the bottom row that never got back in place was reattached, yep, that's the one that always hurts so much. The teeth with the rubber bands are moving at a snail's pace, and my upper lip got rubbed raw into an ulcer again; even with orthodontic wax on, it still hurts. This hurts, that hurts, lately my gums keep bleeding when I brush. Dr. Feng said my gums are a bit swollen and told me to brush harder, but brushing hard really hurts. When I left, I scheduled the next appointment for January 6th in advance. It's been almost a year like this, and the gaps between my teeth are still so big—the progress is so slow you can't even see it. It's been one year, should we celebrate? A very ceremonial happy one-year braces anniversary 😊 It will be happy, right!(^O^)y

items.original: 这是南淮城边的小铺子，靠近富商褚氏的林场，外面是一眼望不尽的松杉林。伐木的劳力每天回城都从小道边过，于是有了这样一个简陋的小铺子。夜深，铺子里只剩下最后一桌客人，没有一个人说话，静得发寒。 　　雪地上点着无数的火盆，照得周围一片通明，人影交叠，不知道多少人围在帐篷周围。看见这一幕，他们全部惊恐地跪了下去，巴夯也跪下。只有老人昂然地站在人群中央，一手扯着儿子，一手提着重剑，抬起头去看天空。 　　最近我的日子过得很糊涂，一直记不清是哪一天要演讲，直到前天有位朋友打电话给我说∶我们后天在耕莘文教院见　　“谁？”　　“警察局长的大儿子　　“是缅因州吗？”她笑著说#读书微盘点##品质阅读#
items.translation: This is a small shop on the outskirts of Nanhuai City, near the timber forest owned by the wealthy merchant Chu. Outside lies an endless expanse of pine and fir woods. Logging laborers pass by the path daily on their way back to the city, hence this simple shop came to be. Late at night, only one table of customers remains in the shop; no one speaks, and the silence is chilling. Countless braziers light up the snowy ground, illuminating the surroundings brightly, with overlapping shadows—countless people surround the tent. Seeing this scene, they all kneel in terror, Ba Hang also kneels. Only the old man stands proudly at the center of the crowd, one hand pulling his son, the other holding a heavy sword, looking up at the sky. Lately, my days have been muddled; I keep forgetting which day the speech is scheduled, until a friend called me the day before yesterday and said: "We'll meet at Gengxin Cultural and Educational Center the day after tomorrow." "Who?" "The police chief's eldest son." "Is it in Maine?" she said with a laugh. #ReadingMicroRoundup# #QualityReading#

At a restaurant, I used a phone without a SIM card to get Wi-Fi and asked the boss to help me make a call. Suddenly, two "fish" showed up (awkward 2020). One "fish" got angry and left on the spot. Later, while chatting with me, he kept subtly mocking the other "fish" for not being as good as him (men are so jealous). Afterwards, the restaurant boss even added me on WeChat to check on me and ask me out, but he has a wife and two kids! He also seems like a pretty simple guy. What is all this?

items.original: #书单# 《心灵深处的对话》——顾城20190522很美。写了人，人性；写了景，美景；写了故事，写出了每个人的喜怒哀乐，惆怅满怀。有时他很可爱，有时他很深沉，有时他很深情。印在封面上的两首诗就是他的传世佳作了，一首是“黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明”，一首是“你，一会看看我，一会看云。我觉得，你看我时很远，你看云时很近。”简短不简单，同时富有美感。
items.translation: #ReadingList# "Dialogues from the Depths of the Heart" by Gu Cheng 20190522 is beautiful. It writes about people, human nature; it writes about scenery, beautiful views; it writes stories, capturing everyone's joys and sorrows, full of melancholy. Sometimes he is adorable, sometimes he is profound, sometimes he is affectionate. The two poems printed on the cover are his timeless masterpieces: one is "The night gives me black eyes, yet I use them to seek light," and the other is "You, now looking at me, now at the clouds. I feel, when you look at me, you are far away; when you look at the clouds, you are close." Brief yet profound, and full of beauty.

items.original: #我们之间的盐# 最近废话好多，倾诉欲饱和，主要是太无聊了。于是我决定以后就在这条下面逼逼叨叨，这样也不会让大嘎觉得太烦。五月碎碎念收集：1. 我进步了！以前：一天不干点正事就会拼命自责。现在：哈哈！我就是废物！2. 2020了张纪闻和陈诗卉到底什么时候领证，无语子，我狗叫了三年（？）都烦了！3. 昨天看了82年的老片子《城南旧事》，我太喜欢了！林海音的这本原著和曹文轩的所有小说是我童年时期文学启蒙，我真的看了大概有10遍吧。btw每天一部电影就是我的理想生活，喝什么奶茶，不吃饭也可以（其实不可以）。4. Take the bunny and run～/想过离开～我最近两天睡觉都在颅内蹦迪唱这两句，救命！5. 我爱夏天，即使我时刻都想爬进冰箱，即使我一晚上能被咬三十个蚊子包。但是夏天的午后真的很美好！“太阳强烈，水波温柔”，加之蝉鸣噪杂，风扇絮语，或者一下雨就轰隆隆，泥土气扑面而来，让我这种天天怀疑自己是否真实存在的人feel alive。仔细想想，生命中重要的人也都是在夏天遇见的。6. 想  吃  烤  肉  。有什么办法能让我不想吗？如有，请私戳马云领取感恩红包。7. 研究了一下地图，发现去上海以后每天上下班要步行至少30分钟，这意味着不敢骑小黄车的我即将免费收获一轮美黑！我的胆量真的跟尬点一样奇怪：敢开车，但不敢骑车上街，看到汽车经过就“我好怕！”，下一秒就跳车。8. 每天都在yy：什么时候能养狗子啊，什么时候家里有按摩椅啊，什么时候房间里出现一只比我人还高的泰迪熊啊！我真的就这点出息。9. 王女士：我明天要去开卡丁车！我：你就这点追求？王：你一个为了看电视五分钟洗完澡的人还说我？？干什么？10. “认真是一种美德，可惜人们并不普遍具有。”绝了，和大佬一起做project的感觉太爽了，关键是他/她声音还很好听，还会在讨论完正事后表现出对凡间日常生活的关怀，实乃心系八方。我恨不得天天和人家zoom连线。
items.translation: #SaltBetweenUs# Lately I've been talking a lot of nonsense, my urge to vent is saturated, mainly because I'm too bored. So I've decided to just ramble under this post from now on, so it won't annoy everyone too much. May ramblings collection: 1. I've improved! Before: I would desperately blame myself if I didn't do something productive in a day. Now: Haha! I'm just trash! 2. It's 2020, when on earth are Zhang Jiwen and Chen Shihui going to get their marriage certificate? Ugh, I've been barking for three years (?) and I'm tired of it! 3. Watched the old 1982 film "My Memories of Old Beijing" yesterday, I loved it so much! Lin Haiyin's original book and all of Cao Wenxuan's novels were my literary enlightenment in childhood, I've probably read them about 10 times. btw, watching one movie a day is my ideal life, forget milk tea, I could even skip meals (actually no). 4. Take the bunny and run～/Thought about leaving～ I've been mentally dancing and singing these two lines in my head while sleeping the past two nights, help! 5. I love summer, even though I constantly want to crawl into the fridge, even though I can get bitten by thirty mosquito bumps in one night. But summer afternoons are truly wonderful! "The sun is intense, the water ripples gentle," plus the noisy cicadas, the whispering fan, or the rumbling when it rains, the smell of soil hitting your face, making someone like me who constantly doubts my own existence feel alive. Thinking carefully, the important people in my life were all met in summer. 6. Want to eat grilled meat. Is there any way to make me not want it? If so, please privately message Jack Ma to receive a gratitude red envelope. 7. Studied the map a bit, found out that after moving to Shanghai, my daily commute will involve walking at least 30 minutes, which means I, who dare not ride the shared bikes, will soon get a free tan! My courage is really as weird as my awkwardness threshold: dare to drive a car, but dare not ride a bike on the street, see a car pass by and go "I'm so scared!", jump off the bike the next second. 8. Daydream

items.translation: June is a lingering breeze and dust, seeping into the body, teasing every sensory nerve within. items.translation: #Hong Kong Ocean Park Faces Closure# Last time it was Hui Lau Shan, this time it's Ocean Park. When I exchanged to CityU in 2011, I went to Ocean Park twice. Each time there weren't many people. The park is on a mountain, small and exquisite. Once I even ran into my next-door neighbor who was traveling there (what a coincidence!). The cable car🚠 up the mountain isn't high, perfect for someone like me who's timid and afraid of heights. I loved the ocean shows and the jellyfish exhibit the most. My feelings towards Hong Kong are complicated. After all these years, it seems I've automatically erased those bad memories, remembering more the kind and enthusiastic classmates and the happy times with few classes where I could go shopping with my roommate every day. I really want to visit Hong Kong again. Hong Kong, stay strong!

items.original: 印广门清答“一句佛号”一一敏感问题解答第十七问：请问法师，“一句佛号”念到底，能不能往生？答：要看情况。问：怎么讲？答：一、懂得阿弥陀佛真实义，当下往生，一句不念也往生。如大安法师在《净土宗教程》所说“一念顿超，片言即证”。大安法师宣讲“华严四无碍法界”就是阿弥陀佛真实义。读懂《法华经》与《楞严经》所诠一心三藏之义，当下往生，乃至十地、等觉。如印光大师言“法华奥典，妙冠群经，闻即往生，位齐等觉”。“闻”者，“如是我闻”之“闻”，“觉”义，“佛”义。 “觉”到“阿弥陀”，“佛”到“如是我”。如是我闻即如是我佛！如是我觉！阿弥陀佛即阿弥陀闻！阿弥陀觉！又，门内之耳，曰佛曰觉。不是门外之耳，门外之耳曰听。问：我是问那种传统的嘴巴念佛，一句佛号到底的念佛，能不能往生？答：一、念佛念到风吹不动、雨打不进，也能往生。如孟婆念佛。人说“孟婆，你家着火了”。孟婆说“不管它”，一边念佛不停。人说“孟婆，你儿子落水了”。孟婆说“由他去”，一边念佛不停。这样的念佛很难做到。二、念佛念到功夫成片，如净空法师所说“一天当中，没有一事为自己；二十四小时当中，没有一念不是阿弥陀佛”，肯定往生。这也很难做到。印广问：你能做到吗？答：我不能。有这样的人吗？印广答：有。问：谁？答：机器人。问：这么说，念佛不能往生了？答：这可是你说的。我没说。我只说很难。不过，佛倒是说过。问：佛怎说？答：《楞严经.卷六》文殊菩萨代佛对大势至念佛法门进行辩证“诸行是无常，念性元生灭。因果今殊感，云何获圆通？”意思是：行为举止无常（念佛嘴动是行，是为），念佛之念，其本质是生灭法则（后念起，前念灭……），以生灭之因（念佛是因），求不生灭之果（成佛是果），其差距如此之殊，怎能圆满、圆融、圆通？（怎能往生）不过，真正来讲，只要你认准一句佛号，不停地念下去，也能往生。问：那得多少时间？答：无量劫。问：无量劫？到底有多长？答：不好说了。无量就是无量，没有数哇！你不是说一句佛号到底吗？念就是。如果十法界都往生了，你也一定往生。问：为什么？答：大家都成佛了，你跟谁分别？谁跟你分别？你被他力化掉了。问：也就是说，念佛是最低级的法门了？答：N0！是高级法门。法华、楞严一心三藏才是最低级的法门。是学前班的课本。而念佛等无量法门是高级法门。问：为什么？你不是说《法华经》、《楞严经》是经王吗？答：那是佛说！我没说什么王不王，我只是将佛说，转告大家而已。是转告，述而不作。问：为什么是王，又是最低呢？答：因为它是基础课，是悟前起修的方便法门、引导法门。读懂法华、楞严一心三藏之理，无修无证而当下明心见性，成分真即佛。再经过百千万亿年的悟后进修，广修念佛法门等无量高级法门，不断提升品位成究竟、圆满、一百分的佛。海最低，海纳百川，有容乃大。普天之下莫非王土，率土之滨莫非王臣。因为其低，所以是王！因其最低，所以最高！即低即高，故为圆教！重复提醒：无量法门皆是悟后进修的高级法门、方便法门！不可作为悟前起修的基础法门，方便法门！我们不要辜负佛陀法华大会、楞严大会的谆谆教诲！印广门清2018.3.21#高以翔妈妈##动漫##设计美学##拼多多#
items.translation: Yinguang Menqing Answers "One Buddha Name" - Sensitive Question Answer Seventeenth Question: Master, if one recites "one Buddha name" to the end, can one be reborn in the Pure Land? Answer: It depends. Question: How so? Answer: 1. If one understands the true meaning of Amitabha Buddha, one is reborn instantly; even without reciting once, one is reborn. As Master Da'an said in "The Pure Land Religious Course": "One thought instantly transcends, a single word immediately verifies." Master Da'an's explanation of "the Four Unobstructed Dharma Realms of the Huayan Sutra" is the true meaning of Amitabha Buddha. Understanding the meaning of One Mind Three Treasuries as explained in the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra leads to instant rebirth, even to the Ten Grounds and Equal Enlightenment. As Master Yinguang said: "The Lotus Sutra, a profound classic, surpasses all sutras; hearing it leads to rebirth, with a status equal to Enlightenment." "Hearing" refers to the "hearing" in "Thus I have heard," meaning "awakening," meaning "Buddha." "Awakening" to "Amitabha," "Buddha" to "Thus I am." Thus I have heard is Thus I am Buddha! Thus I am Awake! Amitabha Buddha is Amitabha Hearing! Amitabha Awakening! Also, the ear within the gate is called Buddha, called awakening. Not the ear outside the gate; the ear outside the gate is called listening. Question: I am asking about the traditional recitation with the mouth, reciting one Buddha name to the end—can that lead to rebirth? Answer: 1. items.translation: Sigh, I guess with some people you just can't see eye to eye. My dad still treats me like a child even though I'm in my twenties. He thinks I've been having a hard time lately, which is why I feel that without him, I'd have no family left in this world. And I really have been struggling. Compared to my old life, compared to most people my age—being woken up by my brother every night, having to sleep curled up every night, being woken by my brother every morning—it's been so long since I've slept stretched out and woken up naturally. Sometimes, being alone with my brother, cleaning up messes and handling household chores, I'm on the verge of breaking down. Yet some people only feel sorry for my brother. Well, there's nothing to be done. Can't ask for too much. Gotta love myself, love myself the most.

items.original: 夜思集：①睡觉是人世间最好的馈赠。②55岁阿姨情感分享，只顾眼前珍惜眼前的快乐。当眼前的快乐积累到一定数值时，会慢慢成为永久的快乐。当她和小三岁的初恋在一起时，所有人都不认同且觉得不会长久，可是他们已经恩爱了这么多年。且如酒般醇厚，越爱越深。③医院这个地方，生死场景太多了。水池边闲谈随便几句话就能懂得所有由来，太多遗憾也有太多情感。我对此的定义和理解好像在慢慢加深也在慢慢接受。④我拒绝长大的本质原因是逃避现实，这是别人给我一针见血的回复。深知但宁愿逃避，不愿自己独力是因为觉得累和疲惫。可这就是长大，也因此领悟会更深刻。⑤关于朋友，善意和恶意总是会突然存在的矛盾体。那些说着你要是有什么问题就打电话给我们，反正我们闲大抵是可以交心的人了。因为他们的善意是保留联系，汲取温暖，与之而来的恶意则是满满的“威胁”，我若不打电话随即将我拉黑这种话也是从他们口中而来。⑥太多人说活在当下了，那么如何活在当下。若将生死看淡，一切好像也都失去了创造的意义。可这却给予意义仪式感，你的每一个选择行为和对话都会进入一种“活在当下”的模式中。芜湖#困##夜思集##睡眠是馈赠# 芜湖·弋矶山医院
items.translation: Night Thoughts Collection: ① Sleep is the best gift in the world. ② A 55-year-old aunt shares her feelings, focusing on cherishing the happiness before her eyes. When the happiness before one's eyes accumulates to a certain amount, it slowly becomes permanent happiness. When she got together with her first love who is three years younger, everyone disapproved and thought it wouldn't last, but they have been deeply in love for so many years. And like wine, it becomes richer and deeper with time. ③ In hospitals, there are too many scenes of life and death. A casual chat by the water fountain can reveal all the origins; there is too much regret and too much emotion. My definition and understanding of this seem to be slowly deepening and slowly accepting. ④ The essential reason I refuse to grow up is to escape reality, which is the blunt reply others gave me. I know it well but would rather escape; I don't want to be independent because I feel tired and exhausted. But this is what growing up is, and because of this, the understanding becomes more profound. ⑤ Regarding friends, kindness and malice always suddenly coexist as contradictions. Those who say "if you have any problems, just call us, we're mostly free anyway" are probably people you can confide in. Because their kindness is to maintain contact and draw warmth, while the accompanying malice is full of "threats"—words like "if you don't call, I'll block you immediately" also come from their mouths. ⑥ Too many people talk about living in the moment, so how does one live in the moment? If you become indifferent to life and death, everything seems to lose its meaning of creation. Yet this gives meaning a sense of ritual; every choice, action, and conversation you make enters a mode of "living in the moment." Wuhu #tired# #Night Thoughts Collection# #Sleep is a Gift# Wuhu · Yijishan Hospital

items.original: #大学快要毕业时是什么感觉# 今天想来聊一聊kavien哥，一个从新浪做技术转型到创业公司做猎头的传奇人物，有过十几年的摇滚经历，非常年轻的容貌配上沉稳的内心，在下很佩服！今天临近下班时候，碰巧有机会再多聊几句，其实还蛮深刻，转型时自己是空杯心态，认识了很多人，多数都是行业tp，敲代码时已经到去药店不知道怎么买药，每天吃喝都在工位，沟通只求简洁高效，所以现在不惧怕回炉重造，其实很多人缺的不是能力，而是这股认定做到底的勇气，所有人包括父母都不支持，但是我觉得我可以试一把！Just to do it！所以 我现在觉得 我也可以再试一把！2020一起加油吧💪#2020 爱你爱你# 北京·西北旺
items.translation: #What does it feel like when you're about to graduate from college# Today I want to talk about Brother Kavien, a legendary figure who transitioned from technology at Sina to becoming a headhunter at a startup, with over a decade of rock music experience, a very youthful appearance paired with a steady heart—I truly admire him! Just before getting off work today, I happened to have the chance to chat a bit more, and it was quite profound. During his transition, he maintained an empty-cup mindset, met many people, most of whom were industry top performers. When coding, he reached a point where he didn’t even know how to buy medicine at a pharmacy, eating and drinking at his workstation every day, communicating only for brevity and efficiency, so now he isn’t afraid to start over. In fact, what many people lack isn’t ability, but the courage to commit fully. Everyone, including his parents, didn’t support him, but he thought he could give it a try! Just to do it! So now I feel like I can give it another try too! Let’s work hard together in 2020 💪 #2020 Love You Love You# Beijing · Northwest Wang

items.original: 总记得小时候，或靠在书架上，或坐在地上的看爱情小说，会因为男女主角间的纠葛而揪心。但现在会觉得能有空静下心来看一本自己喜欢的书，实在太难。不止是觉得没有时间，而是觉得连本专业，或者是提高能力的书都还有太多太多，如何安心的捧一本闲书。没时间，这是一个极其不负责任，而我也不屑于口，却又会在心底默默念想的词。说出这个词，仿佛就在说自己有时间一定能干成什么一样可笑。这次回来，发现书店虽缩小了营业范围，却没有倒闭，角落处也有几个闲人捧着本闲书，我也得空翻阅一二，心情甚是美丽。
items.translation: I always remember when I was a child, leaning against a bookshelf or sitting on the floor reading romance novels, my heart would ache over the entanglements between the male and female leads. But now I feel it's so hard to find the time and peace of mind to read a book I truly enjoy. It's not just about feeling like there's no time; it's that there are still so many books related to my profession or for improving my skills—how can I comfortably pick up a leisure book? "No time" is an extremely irresponsible phrase, one I disdain to say out loud, yet it's something I silently think to myself. Saying it feels as laughable as claiming that if I had time, I could definitely accomplish something. This time when I returned, I found that although the bookstore had reduced its business scope, it hadn't closed down. In the corners, a few idle people were holding leisure books, and I also had a moment to flip through a couple. My mood was quite beautiful.

items.original: 圣诞节文案#圣诞节来了# -— 🍭  🌿    🥂    💕    🦄    🍬—-     ᵀᴴᴱ   ᴮᴱˢᵀ   ᴵˢ   ᶠᴼᴿ   ᵞᴼᵁ❶ 女巫使用了解药，今晚又是一个平安夜。❷ 别再向圣诞老人许愿要一个完美的女孩子了好吗？我今天差点被绑走三次。❸ 又是一年金钩百！❹ 今年圣诞推迟14天，因为圣诞老人过来要隔离。❺ 我喜欢世界陷入短暂的狂欢。❻ 把麋鹿挂在圣诞树上，把你挂在我心上。❼ 亲爱的圣诞爷爷， 我的圣诞愿望是：人瘦点、钱包鼓点、拜托了，千万别给我搞错了，去年就给我弄反啦。❽ 今天你送我苹果，再过几天我就是你的新年礼物。❾ 如果你有空，陪我过个圣诞节，如果你没有，帮我问问你哥们儿，谢谢。❶⓿ 初雪和热咖啡麋鹿和圣诞树，新年的钟声和倒计时。所有糟糕的都是经历，所有的美好都会在未来相遇。❶❶ 一个月不洗头，为了圣诞节给你一场雪。❶❷ 谢谢大家的圣诞礼物，因为没有收到，所以就不一一感谢了❶❸ 鼻尖上冒了个红痘痘，变成了鲁道夫。想要混进圣诞老人的鹿队，提前看看给我准备的礼物是不是你。❶❹ 别期待圣诞礼物了，别人送你的圣诞礼物已经被我拦截了，你的圣诞礼物只能是我。❶❺  “喜欢圣诞，喜欢跨年，喜欢那种浓烈的节日氛围。所有人都是热热闹闹的，在大张旗鼓地分享快乐，在感受人间一切俗气的浪漫。奔跑着去见想念的人，讲温暖的话，举杯时大声祝愿，“节日快乐”。❶❻ 没人送你圣诞礼物没有关系，可以找我啊，只要你开口，我都没有。❶❼ 圣诞树上小星星，圣诞树下咱开心。❶❽ 圣诞节了有人买帽子么？红的10块，绿的免费。❶❾ 把雪花和星星都挂在圣诞树上。❷⓿ 因为疫情原因，今年圣诞老人不能来中国了 他委托我替大家实现愿望，现在找我许愿 只需五块钱，保你2021心想事成❷❶ 想和我一起过圣诞吗？那就想着吧，年轻人要有自己的梦想。❷❷ 马上圣诞节了，可以送我个苹果吗？我说的是256G的那个。❷❸ 接下来等待我们的可是，路过商场听到的圣诞歌，冰糖甜草莓，便利店保温箱里的热阿华田，一家人在一起吃的火锅，胖胖的红包和从外地回来的知己啊。❷❹ 圣诞节快到了，我不要苹果，不要礼物，不要钱，我只要看到这句话的你永远单身，永远永远。❷❺ 圣诞老人在除了圣诞以外的364天在干什么？

items.original: #希望拥有的##是一个鼓励我 支持我的人#  我很坚强，为了不让爱我的人难过，但事实很脆弱;我爱笑，因为这是好的方法，却把痛伤都放在心底;我很信任朋友，因为我会真心对待每一个，却常常让自己受伤;我很投入，对待一段感情我会认真 说的话做的事我都会当真，结果好像都没结果;我很傻，怕做决定 怕选择 因为会犹豫不决 ，身边需要的是有个鼓励我 支持我的人:我不恨每一个离开过的人 因为都是有原因  每段感情 每个友人 ，距离 时间 信任 性格 适合 这都是要去关心的问题 只要有一项 不能磨合，那么都未必能走到最后……遇见是缘分 离开也是缘分！   我同样期待 下一段感情 友谊  只是害怕了人心叵测 只是不知该以怎样的心情去面对 去维持  难道就不是真心  不是投入能持久的吗？ 我也不知道  每个人都会去 期待更美好的一切 但是期待的未必是好的！   送给自己的——2017/8/5 拉萨·拉萨圣地天堂洲际大饭店
items.translation: #What I hope to have# #is someone who encourages and supports me# I am strong, to avoid making those who love me sad, but in reality I am fragile; I love to laugh, because it's a good method, yet I keep all the pain and hurt deep inside; I trust friends deeply, because I treat everyone sincerely, but often end up getting hurt; I am devoted, in a relationship I take it seriously, I mean every word and action, but it seems like none lead to results; I am foolish, afraid of making decisions, afraid of choices because I hesitate, what I need by my side is someone who encourages and supports me: I don't hate anyone who has left, because there are reasons for each departure, every relationship, every friend, distance, time, trust, personality, compatibility—these are all issues that need attention, if even one can't be reconciled, then it may not last until the end... Meeting is fate, leaving is also fate! I also look forward to the next relationship, friendship, but I am just afraid of the unpredictability of people's hearts, just don't know what mindset to face and maintain it with, isn't it true that sincerity and devotion can last? I don't know either, everyone looks forward to something better, but what is anticipated may not be good! To myself—2017/8/5 Lhasa · InterContinental Lhasa Paradise

items.original: 有人问我要两个孩子和一个有什么区别？1. 人生计划当中没有两个孩子，觉得一个就很好了。理性考虑，可能还是不会有计划要二胎，意外来临，一切都值得！2. 尤其是今年的这几个月疫情，才觉得家里多个孩子，很热闹，两个都有伴儿，不孤单，多大多小都喜欢伴儿。大的没意思了小的玩儿，小的黏着大的。3. 要说经济上多一个肯定花费也跟着增多，但是绝对促进爸爸妈妈的赚钱欲望，会花很多心思考虑怎么不降低生活质量多赚钱。一直的教育理念是拼劲全力给你们生活的必需品，而不是附带品，奢侈品，一定要自己有能力养活自己，不能有依赖思想。4. 不图养儿防老，但想想老了两个比一个热闹。5. 一直到现在更是接受各种各样的生活方式，一个人生活也好，两个人也罢，适合的就是最好的，没有固定模式。但是鉴于他的家庭情况，有两个孩子家里热闹，让家里再增添一份烟火气，也是我对他的心意吧。#成长##二胎##家庭##生活的模样##育儿##一起家庭教育##宝妈分享##亲子教育#
items.translation: Someone asked me what's the difference between having two children and one? 1. There were no two children in my life plan; I thought one was just fine. Rationally, I probably still wouldn't plan for a second child, but when an unexpected one comes, everything is worth it! 2. Especially during the pandemic months this year, I realized having an extra child at home makes it lively. Both have a companion and aren't lonely; everyone likes company, big or small. When the older one gets bored, they play with the younger one; the younger one sticks to the older one. 3. Financially, one more child definitely increases expenses, but it absolutely boosts Mom and Dad's desire to earn money. We'll put a lot of thought into how to earn more without lowering our quality of life. Our consistent parenting philosophy is to strive our hardest to provide you with life's necessities, not extras or luxuries. You must be capable of supporting yourselves and not have a dependent mindset. 4. I don't expect to raise children for old-age support, but I think two will be livelier than one when we're old. 5. Up to now, I've come to accept all kinds of lifestyles. Living alone is fine, living as a couple is fine too; what suits you is best, there's no fixed model. But given his family situation, having two children makes the home lively, adding another touch of life's warmth to the household, which is also my sentiment towards him. #Growth##SecondChild##Family##TheLookOfLife##Parenting##FamilyEducationTogether##MomSharing##ParentChildEducation#

items.translation: I originally wanted to make a back-to-school vlog, but I've been too tired these past two days. Looking at my roommates, they all seem like soft, gentle girls, while I appear tough and hard to approach. On the first day, an older student asked if I had a boyfriend. I said no, and she said I might still be in the same situation three years later, advising me not to follow her example and to find someone quickly. Indeed, I also feel that in three years I'll probably still be like this—unable to start or end things easily, and I hate ambiguity, etc. Maybe it's the shadow from my undergraduate years; I'm a bit afraid of not getting along with my roommates. items.original: 听家里老人讲的一件往事，说是上世纪七十年代末，物资副食供应紧张，一次老爸单位食堂包饺子给大家改善生活，单位一个饭量老大的同事连吃二斤，吃了个肚肚圆，腰不敢弯，水也不敢喝，回家的路上忍不住打了个饱嗝，竟然嗝出一个囫囵饺子，他捡起来掰开一看，闷闷的说：早知道肉馅的就该再吃一斤!
items.translation: A story I heard from an elder in the family: In the late 1970s, when food and non-staple supplies were tight, my dad's workplace canteen made dumplings to improve everyone's meals. A colleague with a huge appetite ate two jin (about 1 kg) until his belly was round, he couldn't bend his waist, and didn't dare drink water. On his way home, he couldn't hold back a burp and actually burped out a whole dumpling. He picked it up, broke it open, and said gloomily: Had I known it was meat filling, I should have eaten another jin!

items.original: 大乘妙法莲华经⚛︎ 虚空也是由我们的心变化出来的。你不能讲它销亡，也不能讲它不销亡，我们要现就现，要销就销。在世间法来讲，虚空不可以销亡，谁也不能咬他一口，谁也不能踢他一脚，是不是？后面讲的「舜若多神」，众生位如果讨厌有形有相的肉团身，想要证虚空身，那就是虚空神。他有个灵体在这里，没有形相，可他就是在！所以舜若多性呢，我们把它分开区别。还有个「虚空藏菩萨」，那是菩萨在读懂了《法华经》《楞严经》，明心见性以后，他也跟虚空神一样证得虚空身，外形都是一样，可是里面境界不一样。舜若多神他证到虚空身也是福报啊，他不受苦了！他福报满了以后还要往下落，所以舜若多神是有福报的鬼王之类的。但虚空藏菩萨他只会往上升，究竟成佛！他不会往下落。四空天的天人也可以视为舜若多神、天神。「烁迦罗」翻译成汉语是「坚固」的意思。「烁迦罗心无动转」，我坚固的菩提心不会动摇！~宋清芳诗歌#世界佛法##佛学大智慧#  宋清芳卍山西朔州的微博视频#诗词##海报##哔哩哔哩动画##蔡徐坤#
items.translation: The Great Vehicle Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra⚛︎ Emptiness is also manifested from our mind. You cannot say it vanishes, nor can you say it does not vanish; it appears when we want it to appear and vanishes when we want it to vanish. In terms of worldly dharma, emptiness cannot vanish; no one can bite it, no one can kick it, right? Later, it mentions "舜若多神" (Śūnyatā deities): if sentient beings dislike the tangible, physical flesh body and wish to realize the emptiness body, that is the emptiness deity. It has a spiritual entity here, without form, yet it exists! So regarding the nature of Śūnyatā, we differentiate it. There is also "虚空藏菩萨" (Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva), who, after comprehending the Lotus Sutra and the Śūraṅgama Sutra, realizing the mind and seeing the nature, also attains the emptiness body like the emptiness deity. Their external forms are the same, but their inner realms differ. The Śūnyatā deity attaining the emptiness body is also due to merit; it no longer suffers! After its merit is exhausted, it will still fall, so the Śūnyatā deity is a kind of ghost king with merit. But Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva only ascends, ultimately attaining Buddhahood! It will not fall. The deities of the Four Formless Heavens can also be considered Śūnyatā deities, celestial beings. "烁迦罗" translates to "firm" in Chinese. "烁迦罗心无动转", my firm bodhi mind will not waver! ~ Song Qingfang Poetry #WorldBuddhism##BuddhistWisdom# Song Qingfang 卍 Shanxi Shuozhou Weibo Video #Poetry##Poster##Bilibili Animation##Cai Xukun#

items.original: zxz002【夏季小心眼病】夏季头部更容易出汗，汗水流入眼睛会刺激眼角膜，导致眼睛发红，不过通常红眼症状会很快消失。但是乱揉眼睛及游泳池水质不达标等都会导致急性结膜炎。另外，夏天也是过敏性结膜炎的高发季节，细菌性结膜炎结膜发红，有大量的黏稠分泌物，以及畏光多泪等。
items.translation: zxz002【Be Cautious of Eye Diseases in Summer】In summer, the head tends to sweat more easily. Sweat flowing into the eyes can irritate the cornea, causing redness, though this symptom usually disappears quickly. However, rubbing eyes improperly or swimming in pools with substandard water quality can lead to acute conjunctivitis. Additionally, summer is a high-incidence season for allergic conjunctivitis. Bacterial conjunctivitis involves redness of the conjunctiva, abundant sticky discharge, as well as photophobia and excessive tearing.

items.original: 片言即证——法海淘宝39￼ 搜孤救孤10小时前 · 大连观海文化传播有限公司董事长 教育领域创作者六方佛护——法海淘宝39玄机之二:“广长舌相”“各于其国，出广长舌相，遍覆三千大千世界，说诚实言”。(一)、俗谛质疑:1、佛舌遍覆大千，遮天蔽日，是何景观？2、有以“文殊三世不打诳语，舌可覆面”而作衬解。不禁要问，这大舌头，云何藏于蛋大之口？云何嚼食咽汤？云何利索言语？3、如是“说诚实言”，云何令人信解？诚服？(二)、真谛探索:1、“各于其国”者，世界、宇宙、万物，宏大至天地，细微至发梢，乃至邻虚尘……无非法身真常！无非报化妙用！个个堪称其国！当由、当人、当事、当处、当时、迷悟之分！确确实实、真真切切、并无本质之别！所谓本真自真，何待他求！所谓虚妄本妄，何待破除！是为“说诚实言”！2、“出广长舌”者，当人自性佛菩，虽名本具，不经来人指点，亦如衣裹明珠，不得真实妙用。是故，自觉觉他，布道度人，实乃佛菩利他天责！又当觉时，觉于万法。杂色奇鸟无非“和雅之韵”！众宝行树岂不“微妙之音”？乃至行云流水无非“广长舌相”！所谓“百草头上祖师意，溪水无非广长舌”！众生各以同分妄见，不见自他共性！唯以别业妄见，枉自于异己受报！感慨:望文生义，三世佛冤！既辜佛陀良苦用心！亦负众生法身慧命！难怪众生不信佛啊！难怪众生难信佛啊！皆因“用世语言，入佛知见……但有言说，俱无实义”(《楞严经·卷三、四》)2019.10.27(下期预告:不可思议)              🌸 #佛##佛教##佛法看世间##推文##亚洲好书榜##智慧语录##法师开示##我在未来等你##佛学常识##情感语录#陈立农#熊猫守护者#
items.translation: A Single Phrase as Proof - Fahai Taobao 39. The Mystery of the Six Directions Buddha Protection - Fahai Taobao 39 Part Two: "The Broad and Long Tongue Mark" "Each in his own land, manifests the broad and long tongue mark, covering the three thousand great thousand worlds, speaking truthful words." (I) Conventional Truth Inquiry: 1. The Buddha's tongue covers the great thousand, obscuring the sky and sun—what kind of sight is that? 2. Some use "Manjusri, throughout three lifetimes, never speaks falsely; his tongue can cover his face" as a comparative explanation. One cannot help but ask: How can such a large tongue be hidden in a mouth the size of an egg? How can it chew food and swallow soup? How can it speak fluently? 3. Speaking such "truthful words," how can they make people believe and understand? Sincerely submit? (II) Ultimate Truth Exploration: 1. "Each in his own land" refers to the world, the universe, all things, vast as heaven and earth, minute as a hair's tip, even to the smallest particle... all are nothing but the Dharma-body's true constancy! All are nothing but the wonderful function of reward and transformation! Each can be called its own land! It depends on the distinction between delusion and enlightenment in the situation, the person, the matter, the place, and the time! Truly, really, genuinely, there is no essential difference! So-called fundamental truth is self-truth, why seek elsewhere! So-called falsehood is inherently false, why need to eliminate it! This is "speaking truthful words"! 2. "Manifests the broad and long tongue" refers to the self-nature Buddha and Bodhisattva within each person. Although called inherently possessed, without guidance from a coming one, it is like a pearl wrapped in clothing, unable to attain true wonderful function. Therefore, self-enlightenment and enlightening others, preaching and liberating people, are truly the heavenly duty of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to benefit others! Furthermore, at the moment of enlightenment, one is enlightened to all dharmas. Variegated strange birds are nothing but "harmonious and elegant melodies"! Jeweled rows of trees are surely "subtle and wonderful sounds"! Even flowing clouds and running water are nothing but the "broad and long tongue mark"

items.translation: Dandan's Weekly Journal: Today I rode a shared bike around the neighborhood by myself for about an hour and a half, enjoying the scenery. I rode slowly and aimlessly through this city where I've worked for about five years, and I realized I still really like Shanghai here. I like the transportation the most—you can take the subway anywhere, so convenient. If I ever have to leave here one day, I'll definitely miss it a lot. Cycling is a great way to relax; I plan to go out for a ride for an hour or so every week from now on—it's good for both exercise and reflecting on life. Another happy thing this week is that I passed my Intermediate Economic Law exam. The regret is that I didn't stick to studying, so I didn't take the other two exams this year, but take it slow. Since I didn't have time this year, I'll leave them for next year, haha. Gotta keep a good mindset; taking things slowly is always good. Life is more interesting when you take it day by day. The weekend went by so fast. Good night~ #DailyLife #Shanghai

items.original: 石头城位于江苏省南京市鼓楼区，是一处六朝时期的著名遗迹，遗址位于现清凉山一带，有“东吴第一军事要塞”之称。它扼守秦淮河与长江的交汇口，“因山以为城，因江以为池，地形险固，尤有奇势”，是保障建康城西部安全的军事重镇，也是六朝时期兵家必争之地。南京民间中有关鬼脸城的传说很多。相传这块岩石原来犹如刀削一般，光滑如境。如今在鬼脸城西侧确有一处清亮的池塘，从水面的一侧可以看到鬼脸城的倒影，老南京人俗称之为“鬼脸照镜子”。
items.translation: Shitoucheng, located in the Gulou District of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, is a famous relic from the Six Dynasties period. The site is situated in the present-day Qingliang Mountain area and is known as the "First Military Fortress of Eastern Wu." It guards the confluence of the Qinhuai River and the Yangtze River. "Using the mountain as a wall and the river as a moat, the terrain is perilously solid and uniquely strategic." It served as a crucial military stronghold protecting the western security of Jiankang City and was a contested strategic point during the Six Dynasties period. There are many folk legends in Nanjing about the "Ghost Face City." It is said that the rock was originally as smooth as a mirror, as if cut by a knife. Today, there is indeed a clear pond on the west side of Ghost Face City, where the reflection of Ghost Face City can be seen from one side of the water surface. Old Nanjing residents commonly refer to this as "Ghost Face Looking in the Mirror."

items.original: 抑郁症睡了一天，又是无眠的夜晚。做了一个很长很长很长的噩梦，发现自己不愿意醒来，梦里有你啊。梦到你突然给我发消息说想我了，一如往常的叫我，我好开心，等这么久你终于找我了。但这是噩梦的开始，就如同期待越高失望越大。好几次想要醒来下一秒又坠入梦中，心甘情愿且无能为力。
items.translation: Depression had me sleeping all day, another sleepless night. Had a very, very long nightmare and found myself unwilling to wake up, because you were in the dream. Dreamt that you suddenly messaged me saying you missed me, calling me as usual, I was so happy, after waiting so long you finally reached out. But that was the start of the nightmare, just as higher hopes lead to greater disappointment. Several times I wanted to wake up, the next second I fell back into the dream, willingly and helplessly.

items.translation: Actually, I really hope this life ends quickly—not that my life ends early, but that a lifetime, living to old age and dying naturally, could be sped up. I'm lazy, have no goals, just drifting along waiting to die. So let this life end quickly.

items.original: 17.06.03你说不想聊不开心的事情，可是于我而言我即便能坚守却也不知道能坚守多久，我依然抱有那份坚持和信念，我想给你幸福，而不是只能让你被动去接受，连改变的权利都没有。这一百步我还在继续走，也许不远的未来即将走到第九十九步，那在那之后你会怎样？我很害怕去面对，因为我怕如果你真的伤了我，我会再也回不了头。
items.translation: 17.06.03 You said you didn't want to talk about unhappy things, but for me, even if I can hold on, I don't know how long I can hold on. I still hold onto that persistence and belief. I want to give you happiness, not just make you passively accept it, without even the right to change. I'm still taking these hundred steps; perhaps in the near future, I'll reach the ninety-ninth step. What will you do after that? I'm very afraid to face it because I'm afraid that if you really hurt me, I'll never be able to turn back.

items.translation: Finally, I don't have to watch countless videos over and over to dissect the moves anymore. Finally, I don't have to rehearse non-stop from noon till night anymore. Finally, I don't have to worry about my knees getting scraped raw anymore. Sour, sweet, bitter, spicy—it was all cheerleading. I've felt isolated, I've gotten angry, and I've also laughed and been happy. Stuck in a room for seven hours choreographing, rehearsing the routine repeatedly over dozens of hours. This was the grueling process back then, yet it's also my fondest memory now. Although time will wash everything away, cheerleading remains a sense of belonging, a significant point in my university life. What I gained wasn't just those few moves or a couple of certificates, but clear self-awareness and precious friendships. Maybe I didn't have enough passion or exceptional talent, but I truly cherished every performance and loved every stage. Starting anew, I hope everyone can achieve what they desire.

items.original: 杨幂#杨幂粉丝#我不是在她爆火的时候认识的她，出演宫的时候我甚至还不认识她，也没有看这部剧，当然更没有开始了解娱乐圈。我不是因为她有多火多厉害而粉的她，我最初就仅仅是心疼这个女孩而爱上了她。初二那年无意间看见了她的个人资料和一些经历，真的觉得这个女孩很努力，努力的让人心疼。然后我就开始关注她，发现她真的有在发光哦~ 和别人也都是很骄傲的说我是杨幂的粉丝！！ 她做到了啊，不会让我们觉得成为她的粉丝是件丢脸的事。我现在大二了，是粉幂的第七年。我是很佛系的粉丝，没有做过什么数据，打榜也很少。我就经常关注幂幂的作品，支持她的电视剧电影，看看她的采访啊综艺之类的，买买周边这种。我作为蜜蜂中的小小只，我不觉得我真正为我杨幂做了些什么。相反，我粉她的过程中，自己倒是收获了不少。因为她，我开始关注各种各样的公益，也努力像她一样去传递温暖。幂幂真的给了我满满的正能量啊，我也开始学着努力去坚持。每次想放弃的时候，想想幂就又元气满满了。难过的时候，看看幂幂的月牙笑，心情也真的会突然变好啊(呜呜呜笑起来也太甜太可爱太好看了8) 现在也是，我只要看见幂的脸，我就开心啊。幂真的超级可爱呢，超级想抱抱她。我们幂也真的很优秀啊，长得还那么好看又努力上进，还关心粉丝，也超有梗，还很敬业。作为粉丝的话，杨幂幸福就是最开心的事啦。无论什么时候，我都希望我们小幂做她自己，开心就好。下个十年，我还在。晚安，蜜蜂们~ 晚安，我的宝贝@杨幂
items.translation: Yang Mi #YangMiFans# I didn't know her when she became explosively popular. When she starred in "Palace", I didn't even know her, nor did I watch that drama, and of course, I hadn't started learning about the entertainment industry yet. I didn't become her fan because of how popular or amazing she is; initially, I just fell in love with her because I felt sorry for this girl. In my second year of junior high, I accidentally saw her personal profile and some of her experiences, and I really thought this girl worked so hard, so hard it was heartbreaking. Then I started paying attention to her and discovered she really shines~ And I proudly tell others I'm Yang Mi's fan!! She made it happen; she doesn't make us feel embarrassed about being her fans. I'm now a sophomore in college, my seventh year being a Mi fan. I'm a very laid-back fan; I haven't done any data work, and I rarely participate in voting. I often follow Mi Mi's works, support her TV shows and movies, watch her interviews and variety shows, and buy merchandise and such. As a tiny bee in the hive, I don't feel I've really done anything for my Yang Mi. On the contrary, during the time I've been her fan, I've gained a lot myself. Because of her, I started paying attention to various charitable causes and strive to spread warmth like she does. Mi Mi really gives me so much positive energy, and I've also started learning to persevere. Whenever I want to give up, thinking of Mi fills me with energy again. When I'm sad, looking at Mi Mi's crescent-moon smile really suddenly makes my mood better (sob, her smile is too sweet, cute, and beautiful). Even now, just seeing Mi's face makes me happy.
