items.original: 【泡脚最佳水温】许多人觉得只要在自己的承受范围内，水温自然是越高越好，其实并不然。泡脚的最佳水温在50℃以下，要求热而不烫，感受水温不要用手去测量，最好就是用脚去感受。水温过高脚上的血管容易过度扩张，体内血液更多地流向下肢，引起心、脑、肾等重要器官供血不足。
items.translation: [Best Water Temperature for Foot Soaking] Many people think that as long as it's within their tolerance, the hotter the water, the better—but that's actually not true. The optimal water temperature for foot soaking is below 50°C; it should feel hot but not scalding. Don't test the temperature with your hand; it's best to use your foot to gauge it. If the water is too hot, the blood vessels in your feet can over-dilate, causing more blood to flow to the lower limbs and reducing blood supply to vital organs like the heart, brain, and kidneys.

items.original: #育儿分享# 今天周一儿子要去上幼儿园，他又开始不想去了，这实在太正常了，因为家里有爱他的爸爸妈妈、家里很温暖、有电视看、有手机玩、有零食吃、家里哪哪都熟悉，可是幼儿园不一样幼儿园陌生、小朋友陌生、老师陌生他没有掌控感，他需要适应、需要熟悉、是要有一个过程的，这个过程就是在幼儿园有不断的问题需要他去应对，解决问题之后的成就感就是自己给的，这就是成长。家里有家里的好，幼儿园有幼儿园的好，而我们父母要做的就是坚定，而父母的这种坚定的力量就会成为他的勇气，他需要父母坚定的力量推他一把。如果哭闹就可以妥协，可能未来的目标就是有这种怕的心里，就是这么一念之差就失之交臂了，只是在这个时候坚定一下就成了。我抱着儿子说你不想去幼儿园你哭的话爸爸会打你这我管不了，妈妈不会打你妈妈都理解你理解你想妈妈爸爸、想家，可是爸爸妈妈的共同目标就是今天你必须去幼儿园。后来我儿子终于想去幼儿园了，是因为他想给小朋友看他的一个小玩具，就像是去幼儿园有了一个自己想要达成的目标，有了这个目标就有了他想去的动力。
items.translation: #ParentingShare# Monday today, my son has to go to kindergarten, and he started not wanting to go again. This is completely normal because at home there are parents who love him, it's warm, there's TV to watch, phones to play with, snacks to eat, and everything is familiar. But kindergarten is different—it's unfamiliar, the kids are unfamiliar, the teachers are unfamiliar, he has no sense of control. He needs to adapt, to get familiar, it's a process. This process means there are constant problems at kindergarten he needs to handle, and the sense of achievement after solving them is his own—that's growth. Home has its good points, kindergarten has its good points, and what we parents need to do is be firm. This firmness from parents becomes his courage; he needs that firm push from his parents. If we compromise because of crying, maybe future goals will be met with this kind of fear, and it's just a narrow miss because of that one thought—it just takes being firm at this moment. I held my son and said, "If you don't want to go to kindergarten and cry, Dad might hit you, I can't control that. Mom won't hit you; Mom understands you, understands that you miss Mom and Dad, miss home. But our common goal as parents is that you must go to kindergarten today." Later, my son finally wanted to go to kindergarten because he wanted to show his little toy to the kids. It's like having a goal he wants to achieve at kindergarten, and with that goal, he had the motivation to go.

items.original: 我身边不少朋友都想知道我的微博我不想告诉的原因其实很简单 并不是我有多摆架子 一个没什么人关注的微博谈不上摆不摆架子只是在这里的 并不是你们看到的 你们认为的平时样子的我在这里或许聚集了我心里最悲伤最阴暗最丧的事我对这世界所有的爱恨交织都会在这里坦白这里不会有熟人担子 我不必去营造出任何的人设形象 这里有我的过去 我的期冀 我的野心 我愿意倾吐的一切 我不知道是否应该让你们看到 这穷凶极恶的我在这里有 我都不知道应该去怎么面对的自己
items.translation: Many of my friends around me want to know why I don't want to tell them my Weibo. The reason is actually very simple. It's not that I'm putting on airs—a Weibo with hardly any followers can't really be about putting on airs. It's just that what's here isn't the me you see, the me you think is my usual self. Perhaps what gathers here are the saddest, darkest, most despairing things in my heart. All my intertwined love and hatred for this world will be confessed here. There are no acquaintances here to burden me; I don't have to create any persona. Here lies my past, my hopes, my ambitions, everything I'm willing to pour out. I don't know if I should let you see this utterly vicious me that exists here, the self I don't even know how to face.

items.translation: 3.8: I want this season of unpredictable hot and cold to pass quickly! (Not that I dislike it—I really love the sunny days in March~) I want to have a period where I don't dream every night when I sleep! (It's so hard to fall asleep after school starts, and my sleep is so light~) I want to seriously focus on the things I need to do now! (After doing a few Office practice questions, I frustratingly got sleepy~) I want to go running or walking on the track a few times a week! (I feel too lonely to go alone, so I keep putting it off~) ...... ...... I want to walk stepping on my own shadow, fiddle with my shirt buttons, and check my coat pockets! (But I found it's a rainy day, and I'm wearing a hoodie and a coat without pockets~) I'll just eat lots and lots of tomatoes 🍅 instead, since I've been absolutely loving them lately!

items.original: #十九大#中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会（简称党的十九大）于2017年10月18日在北京召开。党的十九大，是在全面建成小康社会决胜阶段、中国特色社会主义发展关键时期召开的一次十分重要的大会。承担着谋划决胜全面建成小康社会、深入推进社会主义现代化建设的重大任务，事关党和国家事业继往开来，事关中国特色社会主义前途命运，事关最广大人民根本利益。大会将选举产生新一届中国共产党中央委员会和中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会。
items.translation: #19th National Congress# The 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, held in Beijing on October 18, 2017, was a highly significant meeting convened during the decisive stage of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and a critical period for the development of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It undertook the major task of planning the decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and advancing the socialist modernization drive, bearing on the continuity and development of the Party and the country's endeavors, the future and destiny of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and the fundamental interests of the broadest population. The Congress elected a new Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and a new Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

items.original: 心无挂碍，是一种至高的生活方式。在生命的漂泊中，只有不念过去，放下苦乐束缚才能活得简单自在、优雅从容。心无挂碍，是一种超然的大境界。在不安的世界里，只有放下执念，抛开焦虑烦恼。才能让内心回归平和，活出人生的最好时节。——林清玄《心无挂碍 无有恐惧》
items.translation: To be free from attachments is the highest way of life. In the drifting journey of life, only by not dwelling on the past and letting go of the shackles of joy and sorrow can one live simply, freely, elegantly, and calmly. To be free from attachments is a transcendent state of being. In an unsettled world, only by relinquishing obsessions and casting aside anxiety and worries can one restore inner peace and live out the best season of life.—Lin Qingxuan, "Free from Attachments, Free from Fear"

items.original: 虞书欣 🎂#虞书欣1218生日快乐# 虞书欣  生日快乐🎂🎊12.18一个特殊的日子，我的女孩降临在了这个世界。很多人都知道她出生家境优越，可她从小就被父母穷养，没有零花钱，不敢跟父母要很贵的东西，后来班里同学有背很好看的包包，她也想要，父母不给她买后来她想当偶像，但是父母想让她继承家产，告诉她：“如果你28岁之前出不了名，就回来继承家业”她——去做了"一年级"里的你因为“作”被很多人骂，但你一直很乐观，那是我第一次认识你下一站是幸福里的蔡敏敏古灵精怪，你饰演女二，记得有段剧情男女主很虐，是女二和男二支撑着我看下去，后来我比起主角，更喜欢这一对，那是我第一次喜欢你那天上午阳光正好，我躺在床上打开aqy，不知道看什么，却刷到了“少主且慢行”那是第一天上线，虞书欣演的古装剧，我从来不看古装剧，但是那一次我看到了你，我就想要尝试，我点了进去，里面的剧情太吸我了，那是我第一次喜欢古装剧，那一天我躺在床上追了一天的剧，追到了晚上……看到最后那个抢亲唱歌的地方，我居然哭了，我知道我看电视剧从来不哭，许多大事我都不会哭，但不知道为什么那一次我哭了，我也很奇怪，因为那部剧真的太好了！真的是我有史以来最喜欢的一部剧，我看完立马就去二刷了，那是我开始决定追你的第一次后来我知道你要去参加青春有你2，我很吃惊，我超级高兴的为你加油，一定要送你C位出道，开播的那天，并没有那么好。因为说话作作的，被骂上了热搜第一，那一天晚上真的真的很伤心，很累，一直在忙，反黑，超话，发稿，安利后来你的“哇偶”吸粉无数，很多人都真香打脸，你很可爱很真实初舞台的“爱你”火了很久，后来你的一个个舞台，你次次举动和镜头，粉丝渐渐多了起来，我叫着很多朋友，帮忙每天投票，🍊的时候也少不了我最终第二出道，那时有很多争议，你依然很开心，然后就接了越来越多的广告和综艺，越来越忙，但是你每次在镜头前都能给我们带来快乐，我很骄傲我喜欢的人是你宝贝希望你永远开心快乐，不止生日一定要在你所热爱的世界里闪闪发亮✨虞书欣   生日快乐。🎊🎂                                                 ——12.12lgc
items.translation: Yu Shuxin 🎂#HappyBirthdayToYuShuxin1218# Yu Shuxin, happy birthday 🎂🎊 December 18th, a special day, my girl came into this world. Many people know she was born into a wealthy family, but she was raised frugally by her parents since childhood, had no pocket money, and didn't dare ask for expensive things. Later, when classmates had really nice backpacks, she wanted one too, but her parents wouldn't buy it for her. Then she wanted to become an idol, but her parents wanted her to inherit the family business and told her: "If you don't become famous by age 28, come back and inherit the family enterprise." She—went and did it. In "Freshman Year," you were criticized by many for being "annoying," but you always stayed optimistic; that was my first time knowing you. Cai Minmin in "The Next Happiness" was quirky and clever; you played the second female lead. I remember a plot where the main couple was very angsty, and it was the second couple that kept me watching. Later, I preferred that pair over the main leads; that was my first time liking you. That morning, the sunlight was just right, I lay in bed and opened iQiyi, not knowing what to watch, but then I came across "The Untamed" on its first day of release—a historical drama starring Yu Shuxin. I never watch historical dramas, but that time I saw you and wanted to give it a try. I clicked in, and the plot completely drew me in. That was my first time liking a historical drama; that day I lay in bed binge-watching all day, into the night... When I reached the part about snatching the bride and singing, I actually cried. I know I never cry watching TV shows, and I don't cry over many big things, but I don't know why I cried that time; I found it strange too, because that drama was just so good! It's truly my favorite drama ever; I finished it and immediately rewatched it. That was the first time I decided to follow you. Later, I learned you were going to join "Youth With You 2"; I was surprised and super happy, cheering you on, determined to help you debut as center. The day it aired wasn't so great. Because of your "annoying" way

items.translation: After finding out the reason today, I cried for a long time and couldn't stop. Mom: Zong, did the teacher criticize you? Me: No, no. Mom: Did a classmate bully you? Me: No, no. Mom: Is it that you can't keep up with the studies? It's okay, just do what you can, what else can we do? (She seemed very convinced she guessed right.) Me: Fine, let's just say that's it. After telling my friend, my friend joked: Why didn't your mom say "don't cry, don't cry, we just won't study anymore, we won't study anymore"? That cracked me up. And the fact that Mom said it in our local dialect made it even more perfect.

items.original: 喜欢那些说话看起来不正经的人，大大咧咧老是开玩笑，玩世不恭的样子。其实真正了解他们的心，你才会发现，他们活的比谁都认真，比谁都敏感。只是怎么说呢，人生不如意才是十之八九。任何事摊开了揉碎了说，都透着一股悲凉。珍惜你身边每个逗逼吧，他们只是用幽默感努力对抗世界巨大的荒芜。
items.translation: I like those people who seem unserious in their speech, who are always joking around and appear cynical. Actually, only when you truly understand their hearts will you discover that they live more earnestly and are more sensitive than anyone else. It's just that, how to put it, life is mostly unsatisfactory. When anything is laid bare and examined in detail, it reveals a sense of desolation. Cherish every funny person around you; they are just using humor to fight against the immense desolation of the world.

items.original: 连续闷热了好几天，南京终于在今天迎来了一场属于盛夏的暴雨。放假已经好几天了，撑着伞走出G组团的时候，眼帘里除了漫天的雨只有寥寥几个行人，也同样撑着形形色色的伞沿着马路走向自己的目的地。我还是选择从两旁种满榉树的那条道路走向我自己的目的地。每次走这条路我都怀抱着一种莫名的情感，不论是晴天还是下雨天，也不论是冬天还是夏天，它好像都有自己独特的样子。两旁的榉树长得又高又直，随性生长的纤细枝叶在马路中央的上空汇合，春天会冒出很浅很浅的绿色的叶子，到了夏天浅绿色会慢慢变得更深，就好像被盛夏的阳光晒得老化了一样，秋天开始掉叶子，所以冬天的时候抬头只能看见光秃秃的树枝了，幕布是灰沉沉的天空。四季流转里，只有来来往往的同学陪着这些树，以及两旁的红墙与河水。今天终于是有暴雨的日子了，马路上不再是一成不变的树荫轮廓，而是稀里哗啦的小水流。因为没有人，所以我肆无忌惮地踩着中线一步一步地走，溅得自己满脚满裤子的水也毫不在意，急速降落在我的伞面的雨水又顺着脊线下落，为我隔出一个朦胧胧的小世界。在我的记忆里，每一个盛夏都应该有一场说来就来的暴雨的，即使把所有的门窗都关好，还是听得见屋外水花四溅的声音，所有的乌云遮蔽了天空，所以室内也是一片昏暗。等到暴雨停歇，就可以见到被雨洗过的天空，被雨洗过的空气，被雨洗过的叶子……被雨洗过的一切，连夏日的暑气都被清洗一空，轻轻地嗅一嗅，还能闻到未消散完的涩涩的雨水的味道啊。这场雨所有的水如果没有来得及挥发一空的话，会顺着蜿蜒的道路一直汇聚到长江，最后奔流入海。所有天上来的精灵，最后都会回到大海的怀抱里，这样一想，好像有点浪漫的样子❤ 南京·中国药科大学(江宁校区)
items.translation: After several consecutive days of sweltering heat, Nanjing finally welcomed a summer downpour today. It's been several days since the holiday began. When I walked out of Building G with an umbrella, my view held nothing but the sweeping rain and a few scattered pedestrians, also holding various umbrellas, walking along the road toward their destinations. I still chose to walk toward my own destination via the road lined with zelkova trees. Every time I take this road, I'm filled with an inexplicable emotion. Whether it's sunny or rainy, winter or summer, it seems to have its own unique appearance. The zelkova trees on both sides grow tall and straight, their freely growing slender branches and leaves meeting overhead in the middle of the road. In spring, very pale green leaves emerge. By summer, the light green slowly deepens, as if aged by the midsummer sun. Leaves begin to fall in autumn, so in winter, looking up, you only see bare branches against the backdrop of a gloomy, gray sky. Through the changing seasons, only the coming and going students accompany these trees, along with the red walls and the river on either side. Today finally brought the heavy rain. The road was no longer a monotonous silhouette of tree shade but filled with the sound of rushing little streams. Because there was no one around, I walked unabashedly down the center line, step by step, not minding the water splashing all over my feet and pants. The rain rapidly landing on my umbrella flowed down the spine, creating a hazy little world around me. In my memory, every midsummer should have a sudden, heavy downpour. Even with all the doors and windows closed, you can still hear the sound of water splashing outside. All the dark clouds blot out the sky, so the indoors are dim too. When the rain stops, you can see the rain-washed sky, the rain-washed air, the rain-washed leaves... everything washed by the rain, even the summer heat cleansed away. Take a gentle sniff, and you can still smell the lingering, astringent scent of the rain. If all the water from this rain doesn't evaporate in time, it will flow along the winding roads, eventually converging into the Yangtze River and rushing out to sea. All the spirits from the sky eventually return to the embrace of the sea. Thinking of it this way seems a bit romantic ❤ Nanjing · China Pharmaceutical University (Jiangning

items.translation: A little demon has crept into my heart lately, stirring up trouble from time to time. I find myself inexplicably sinking into a very negative and gloomy mood, disliking or even hating who I am now. It feels like my mind has caught a cold. In the end, I’ll just have to spend an unknown amount of time alone working through it.

items.original: 安逸的人生，谁不想拥有。只是，这种安逸，应该是经历奔波岁月后，内心的愉悦富足。它不是年轻时逃避艰辛的理由，它无关享受，无关迷茫，而是内心对未知世界的渴望。什么年龄段做什么事，在还能做梦的年纪，请不要轻易选择妥协。#欢乐颂2#
items.translation: Who wouldn't want a comfortable life? However, this comfort should be the inner joy and fulfillment that comes after years of striving. It is not an excuse to avoid hardship in youth; it is not about indulgence or confusion, but an inner yearning for the unknown world. Do what is appropriate for your age; in the years when you can still dream, please do not easily choose to compromise. #Ode to Joy 2#

items.original: 10.23 第一次梦见她 她回来了第二次梦见她回来了 场景和第一次一模一样一样到 现在想起来都很诧异11.28 第三次 梦见她 她没有回来梦里 她另婚嫁 怀着两个月的孕 冷漠地对我说“我已经有家了 不要来找我我不要你们了 不想再看到你”现实中 我在想 这应该 是真的吧…我是被抛弃了的…
items.translation: 10.23 First time dreaming of her. She came back. Second time dreaming she came back. The scene was exactly the same as the first, so identical it's still shocking to recall. 11.28 Third time dreaming of her. She did not come back. In the dream, she had married another, two months pregnant, and said coldly to me, "I have a family now, don't come looking for me. I don't want you anymore, I don't want to see you again." In reality, I'm thinking, this is probably true... I was abandoned...

items.original: 最看不惯发生任何事情就上升到国家的人。14亿人什么样的变态不会出现，林子大了什么样的鸟不会有。如果国家在每个人体内植入芯片24小时监视，这些人一样还是跳脚吐口水的人。不是说国家没错，最大的错我觉得是判刑太轻犯罪成本低，但是国家才成立70年，它才70岁，它还需要时间一点一点摸索前进。生活中我也遇到很多黑暗（警察收保护费抓走我的家人都遇到过），但是我一直相信这只是因为哪个行业都有坏人，但是国家，是在进步的。有时候觉得人真的安逸久了就变了，才几年的时间，抗日战争时的热血为国英勇无畏就基本见不到了，剩下的只有自己能得到多少福利，只有拿国家跟世界所有国家美好一面的对比，只有一句调侃，“你国不行”。
items.translation: I can't stand people who escalate everything to the level of the nation. With 1.4 billion people, what kind of perverts wouldn't appear? In a big forest, all kinds of birds exist. Even if the state implanted chips in everyone for 24-hour surveillance, these same people would still be the ones stomping and spitting. It's not that the state is without fault—the biggest mistake, I think, is that sentencing is too lenient and the cost of crime is too low. But the country has only been established for 70 years; it's only 70 years old. It still needs time to grope its way forward bit by bit. In life, I've also encountered much darkness (I've experienced police collecting protection fees and having my family arrested), but I've always believed this is just because every profession has bad people, but the country is progressing. Sometimes I feel people really change after being comfortable for too long. In just a few years, the passionate, brave, fearless patriotism of the War of Resistance era has basically vanished. What remains is only how much welfare one can get, only comparing the country to the best aspects of all nations worldwide, only a mocking phrase: "Your country sucks."

items.original: 无所事事，你只是在逃避现实。我想了很久，还是觉得或者和死亡本身都没有意义，任何事物本身都没有意义，意义本身也不存在，全凭自己怎么看待。不存在什么支撑我活下去的理由，只有在我觉得有什么东西还能让我多看一眼，多听一遍，多吃一次，多笑一次的时候，才能支撑我睡着之后再醒来。可只要一在人群里，就觉得自己的存在没有必要。
items.translation: Doing nothing is just you avoiding reality. I've thought about it for a long time, and I still feel that neither living nor death itself has any meaning, nothing in itself has meaning, meaning itself doesn't exist, it all depends on how you look at it. There is no reason that supports my will to live, only when I feel there is something that can make me look one more time, listen one more time, eat one more time, laugh one more time, can it support me to wake up after falling asleep. But as soon as I'm among people, I feel my existence is unnecessary.

items.original: 我亲爱的陈先生 今天聊天很开心 一放假就开心的我好想你陪嗷。无时无刻都在想你，干什么都在想你，想你的快死去了。可是我不说 我就憋着  打死不承认  然后又默默承认。每次分开就忘记你是怎么抱我 怎么爱护我的  太想念了  甚至就想去有你味道的地方逛一逛  就想去以前我俩共同记忆的地方 快见面吧
items.translation: My dear Mr. Chen, I was very happy chatting today. As soon as the holiday starts, I'm so happy and I miss you terribly and want you by my side. I miss you every moment, I miss you no matter what I'm doing, I miss you so much it's killing me. But I don't say it, I just hold it in, I'd rather die than admit it, and then I silently admit it. Every time we part, I forget how you hold me, how you cherish me. I miss you so much, I even just want to go for a walk somewhere that has your scent, just want to go to places of our shared memories. Let's meet soon.

items.original: 其实让人有所想念的某一瞬间，是以为终有一日，花会开，路会明，太阳迟早会出来。因为那个时候，是明亮的未来，所以会努力的去绘一张蓝图；怎么可能会在知道了这个未来里没有自己的存在还去拼命？我所希望的美好的梦想里，是可以触碰到的清晰的有我存在的未来啊。“那样一个满身骄傲的人，到底是受了多大的委屈才会这样不顾一切地流了两个多小时眼泪啊？”有时候会觉得已经到绝望边缘了。不是“想去死”而是“不想活”。也不是特别多的负面情绪，只是觉得，万事万物，到头不过都是一场空，罢了。没有那个为你而活的人，也没有那个想为之而活的人，走到哪里，都会得到“你觉得那么委屈你就走啊”这样一句话的多余的人。“既然这样，你去死好了。”抑郁症
items.translation: Actually, the moment that makes one miss something is when they believe that one day, flowers will bloom, the road will become clear, and the sun will eventually rise. Because at that time, it was a bright future, so they would strive to draw a blueprint; how could they possibly fight desperately knowing that this future does not include their own existence? The beautiful dream I hope for is a clear, tangible future where I exist. "How much grievance must such a proud person have suffered to cry uncontrollably for over two hours?" Sometimes, it feels like the edge of despair has been reached. It's not "wanting to die" but "not wanting to live." It's not an overwhelming amount of negative emotions, just a feeling that everything, in the end, is nothing but emptiness. There is no one living for you, nor anyone you want to live for. Wherever you go, you are just an extra person who hears, "If you feel so wronged, then leave." "Since that's the case, just go die." Depression

How many people are bound by fame and fortune? How many are troubled by it? We are taught to strive for success and to stand out, but those who succeed and stand out are only a minority; the silent majority is still the majority. items.original: 《平庸》十三是猪圈中众多只猪的一只，不过他是最瘦小的一只，小时候吃奶，它得等到前面的十二猪吃完了才能吃，却没剩多少奶，长大了，猪饲料也吃兄弟姐妹剩下的。它觉得自己平庸的很过分。就做了一个梦，梦里有个老神仙，给了它一株仙草，告诉它吃完了就会变大变胖，成为猪界美男，神草是靠意志生长，你心里想变多大就能变多大。十三受够了这么碌碌无为的活着，如果能一夜暴胖，它死了都愿意。梦想成真，它变成了胖十三，比它妈妈都要胖两圈，主人大喜给它换了一个豪华套房，好吃好喝供着它，它突然有种农奴翻身做地主的快感。只是日子久了，它有点孤单，毕竟无敌是那么寂寞。好久不长，它已经胖到行动都困难了，也长不了多少肉了。其实胖瘦都逃不过被杀的命运。刽子手磨着刀说，这是他见过最肥的猪。十三很自豪它是猪界之最，不过听着磨刀霍霍的声音，它还是怂了。它想回到最初，和兄弟姐妹一起抢食的日子，它不想变得一株惊人，它就变成一只普通猪就行，让时间慢一点在慢一点吧。一鞭子主人把它抽醒了，嘴上骂道:就你不争气，养了这么久就你最瘦。果然是黄粱一梦。它又开心起来，扑腾扑腾在兄弟姐中妹磨蹭抢食，却也抢不到。人跟猪一样总是追求自己得不到的，殊不知此时拥有平庸已是最大的幸福。不是说追求变好不对，而是无论人处的位置高低，美丑富穷，都能不以物喜，不以己悲，心安理得最重要。
items.translation: "Mediocrity" Thirteen was one of many pigs in the pigsty, but he was the skinniest one. As a piglet nursing, he had to wait until the first twelve pigs finished before he could nurse, leaving little milk left. Growing up, he also ate the leftover feed from his siblings. He felt his mediocrity was excessive. So he had a dream where an old immortal gave him a magical herb, telling him that after eating it he would grow big and fat, becoming a handsome male in the pig world. The herb grew through willpower—it would grow as big as he wished in his heart. Thirteen was tired of living such an unremarkable life; if he could become fat overnight, he would be willing to die for it. The dream came true: he became Fat Thirteen, two sizes fatter than his mother. The owner was overjoyed and moved him to a luxurious suite, pampering him with good food and drink. Suddenly, he felt the thrill of a slave turning into a landlord. But as time passed, he grew a bit lonely—after all, being invincible is so isolating. Not long after, he had grown so fat that movement became difficult, and he couldn't gain much more weight. In truth, whether fat or thin, all pigs cannot escape the fate of being slaughtered. The butcher sharpened his knife, saying this was the fattest pig he had ever seen. Thirteen was proud to be the best in the pig world, but hearing the sound of the sharpening knife, he still felt scared. He wanted to return to the beginning, to the days of scrambling for food with his siblings. He didn't want to be shockingly outstanding; he just wanted to be an ordinary pig, wishing time would slow down, slower and slower. A whip from the owner woke him up, cursing: "You're the one who's useless—after raising you for so long, you're still the skinniest." It was indeed a pipe dream. He became happy again, bustling among his siblings, rubbing against them and scrambling for food, yet still unable to get any. Humans, like pigs, always pursue what they cannot have, unaware that the mediocrity they possess at this moment is already the greatest happiness. It's not that striving to improve is wrong, but rather that regardless of one's position—high or low, beautiful or ugly, rich or poor—one should not be overly joyful or sorrowful over

items.translation: In the middle of the night, I suddenly remembered when I was very, very young, my mother would watch the time during my nap, squat by the bed with snacks to coax me awake. I remember her smiling, crescent-shaped eyes and her softly calling me 'darling.' That certain, tangible feeling of being cherished was truly wonderful and I miss it. But from age two or three to now at twenty-three, aside from that time, I can't recall any other similar feelings. Parents aging and me growing up seem to have made us all less adept at expressing the love in our hearts. Of course I know 'this love isn't expressed not because it doesn't exist, but because everyone takes it for granted, so why mention it?' I feel awkward, too shy to say it, and of course others feel the same. I am loved. I'll call my mom tomorrow and chat more. I'll also finish the paper I've been procrastinating on until the last minute. Goodnight.

items.original: 美食 不可辜负的美食 香港 大学Vlog6 ｜在香港｜麦当劳｜逛超市｜石澳小岛｜多鹤野日式料理｜艺术馆看展｜一兰拉面｜除夕夜｜拍全家福｜家庭烧烤      香港的石澳小岛真的很棒，和长洲岛相比这里的游客比较少，很适合周末出来野餐或者放松，有海有草地，有高尔夫球场有很棒的brunch。吹吹海风，绕绕小路，烦躁的心情被安抚不少，岛上的生活真的好惬意啊。      今年我们还是回老家过年，年夜饭、压岁钱、放烟花、全家福…今年又过了一个好年，只可惜病毒来的太猖狂了，大家在老家呆的日子只有短短4天，很多人再见又是明年冬天。      去年我明白了不是所有的努力都有回报。不过即使失败了，当你回过头看你这一路的付出，其实你也收获了许多。时间说溜就溜走，当我发现我没有了要等的人，也没有了陪我一起等的人的时候，才知道年少的爱情、友情、亲情真的都太宝贵啦。现在，从此刻开始，都要好好珍惜身旁的人，也要加倍爱自己噢！ #vlog# #我的vlog生活# #不可辜负的美食# #吃货在这里# #吃吃吃# #美食# #遇见美好# #拯救不开心#  #旅游# #香港# #石澳#  #跨年# #新年快乐# #除夕夜#  做个好梦把的微博视频 香港
items.translation: Food, unmissable food, Hong Kong University Vlog6 | In Hong Kong | McDonald's | Supermarket shopping | Shek O Island | Takuraya Japanese cuisine | Art gallery exhibition | Ichiran Ramen | New Year's Eve | Family photo | Family barbecue. Shek O Island in Hong Kong is really great; compared to Cheung Chau Island, there are fewer tourists here, making it perfect for weekend picnics or relaxation. There's the sea, grass, a golf course, and excellent brunch. Feeling the sea breeze and wandering the small paths soothes a lot of restlessness; life on the island is truly so leisurely. This year we still returned to our hometown for the New Year: New Year's Eve dinner, red envelopes, fireworks, family photos... we had another good New Year, but it's a shame the virus came so fiercely. We only stayed in our hometown for a short four days, and for many, we won't see each other again until next winter. Last year I learned that not all efforts yield rewards. But even if you fail, when you look back at what you've put in along the way, you've actually gained a lot. Time slips away so quickly. When I realized I no longer had someone to wait for, nor anyone to wait with me, I understood how precious youthful love, friendship, and family bonds truly are. Now, from this moment on, cherish the people around you and love yourself twice as much! #vlog# #myvloglife# #unmissablefood# #foodiehere# #eateateat# #food# #encounterbeauty# #saveunhappiness# #travel# #HongKong# #ShekO# #newyear# #happynewyear# #newyearseve# Good dreams in Weibo video Hong Kong
